21.s:
nārada uvāca
sāmānyapūjāṃ viṣṇvādervakṣye mantrāṃś ca sarvadān /
samastaparivārāya acyutāya namo yajet //
:n
1 sāgnayo hy agāditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ, agnipālā varhiṣado hy
ājyapāḥ sāgnayo hy ajāditi gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 vaisāraṇī sute iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 52
21.d:
नारद उवाच
सामान्यपूजां विष्ण्वादेर्वक्ष्ये मन्त्रांश् च सर्वदान् /
समस्तपरिवाराय अच्युताय नमो यजेत् //
:न्
1 साग्नयो ह्य् अगादिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः, अग्निपाला वर्हिषदो ह्य्
आज्यपाः साग्नयो ह्य् अजादिति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 वैसारणी सुते इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 52
21.m:
Nārada said: / I shall declare the general worship of Viṣṇu and others, and the mantras that grant all things. / One should worship saying: "Homage to Acyuta along with his entire retinue."
[Footnote]
1. "sāgnayo hy agāt" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "agnipālā varhiṣado hy ājyapāḥ sāgnayo hy ajāt" in gha.
2. "vaisāraṇī sute" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / [p. 52]

21.s:
dhātre vidhātre gaṅgāyai yamunāyai nidhī tathā /
dvāraśriyaṃ vastunavaṃ śaktiṃ kūrmamanantakam //
21.d:
धात्रे विधात्रे गङ्गायै यमुनायै निधी तथा /
द्वारश्रियं वस्तुनवं शक्तिं कूर्ममनन्तकम् //
21.m: To Dhātṛ, Vidhātṛ, Gaṅgā, Yamunā, and the two treasures, / the fortune of the door, the nine substances, Śakti, Kūrma, and Ananta;

21.s:
pṛthivīṃ dharmakaṃ jñānaṃ vairāgyaiśvaryameva ca /
adharmādīn kandanālapadmakeśarakarṇikāḥ //
21.d:
पृथिवीं धर्मकं ज्ञानं वैराग्यैश्वर्यमेव च /
अधर्मादीन् कन्दनालपद्मकेशरकर्णिकाः //
21.m: Earth, Dharma, knowledge, dispassion, and sovereignty, / Adharma and the rest, the bulb, stalk, lotus petals, filaments, and pericarp;

21.s:
ṛgvedādyaṃ kṛtādyañca satvādyarkādimaṇḍalam /
vimalotkarṣiṇī jñānā kriyā yogā ca tā yajet //
21.d:
ऋग्वेदाद्यं कृताद्यञ्च सत्वाद्यर्कादिमण्डलम् /
विमलोत्कर्षिणी ज्ञाना क्रिया योगा च ता यजेत् //
21.m: the Ṛgveda and the rest, the Kṛta age and the rest, the sattva quality and the rest, the disc of the sun and the rest. / One should worship them: Vimalā, Utkarṣiṇī, Jñānā, Kriyā, and Yogā;

21.s:
prahvīṃ satyāṃ tatheśānānugrahāsanamūrtikām(1) /
durgāṃ giraṅgaṇaṃ(2) kṣetraṃ vāsudevādikaṃ yajet //
21.d:
प्रह्वीं सत्यां तथेशानानुग्रहासनमूर्तिकाम्(1) /
दुर्गां गिरङ्गणं(2) क्षेत्रं वासुदेवादिकं यजेत् //
21.m: Prahvī, Satyā, and likewise the icon on the seat of grace of Īśāna; / one should worship Durgā, Gir, Gaṇa, the field, and Vāsudeva and the others;

21.s:
hṛdayañca śiraḥ śūlaṃ varmanetramathāstrakam /
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ yajet //
21.d:
हृदयञ्च शिरः शूलं वर्मनेत्रमथास्त्रकम् /
शङ्खं चक्रं गदां पद्मं श्रीवत्सं कौस्तुभं यजेत् //
21.m: and the heart, the head, the trident, the armor, the eye, and the weapon; / one should worship the conch, discus, mace, lotus, Śrīvatsa, and Kaustubha;

21.s:
vanamālāṃ śriyaṃ puṣṭiṃ garuḍaṃ gurumarcayet /
indramagniṃ yamaṃ rakṣo jalaṃ vāyuṃ dhaneśvaram //
21.d:
वनमालां श्रियं पुष्टिं गरुडं गुरुमर्चयेत् /
इन्द्रमग्निं यमं रक्षो जलं वायुं धनेश्वरम् //
21.m: one should revere the forest garland, Śrī, Puṣṭi, Garuḍa, the guru, / Indra, Agni, Yama, the Rakṣas, the waters, Vāyu, the lord of wealth,

21.s:
īśānantamajaṃ cāstraṃ vāhanaṃ kumudādikam /
viṣvaksenaṃ maṇḍalādau siddhiḥ pūjādinā bhavet //
21.d:
ईशानन्तमजं चास्त्रं वाहनं कुमुदादिकम् /
विष्वक्सेनं मण्डलादौ सिद्धिः पूजादिना भवेत् //
21.m: Īśāna, Ananta, Aja, the weapon, the mount, Kumuda and the rest, / and Viṣvaksena in the maṇḍala and elsewhere; accomplishment comes through worship and the like.

21.s:
śivapūjātha sāmānyā pūrvaṃ nandinamarcayet /
mahākālaṃ yajedgaṅgāṃ(3) yamunāñca gaṇādikam //
21.d:
शिवपूजाथ सामान्या पूर्वं नन्दिनमर्चयेत् /
महाकालं यजेद्गङ्गां(3) यमुनाञ्च गणादिकम् //
21.m: Now the general worship of Śiva: first one should revere Nandin; / one should worship Mahākāla, Gaṅgā, Yamunā, the Gaṇas, and the rest;

21.s:
giraṃ śriyaṃ(4) guruṃ vāstuṃ śakyādīn dharmakādikam (5) /
vāmā jyeṣṭhā tathā raudrī kālī kalavikāriṇī //
21.d:
गिरं श्रियं(4) गुरुं वास्तुं शक्यादीन् धर्मकादिकम् (5) /
वामा ज्येष्ठा तथा रौद्री काली कलविकारिणी //
21.m: Gir, Śrī, the guru, the site, the powers and the rest, Dharma and the rest; / Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, Raudrī, Kālī, Kalavikāriṇī,

21.s:
balavikariṇī cāpi balapramathinī kramāt /
:n
1 prahvī sandhyā tatheśānānugrahāsanamūrtikā iti ga,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 durgāṃ giriṃ gaṇamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ durgāṃ
śivaṃ gaṇamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 yajet durgāṃ iti kha, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 giriṃ śriyamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ śivaṃ śriyatamiti gha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 gaurīṃ śriyaṃ guruṃ cāstraṃ śaktyādiṃ dharmakādikamiti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 53
sarvabhūtadamanī ca madanonmādinī śivāsanaṃ //
21.d:
बलविकरिणी चापि बलप्रमथिनी क्रमात् /
:न्
1 प्रह्वी सन्ध्या तथेशानानुग्रहासनमूर्तिका इति ग,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 दुर्गां गिरिं गणमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः दुर्गां
शिवं गणमिति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 यजेत् दुर्गां इति ख, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 गिरिं श्रियमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः शिवं श्रियतमिति घ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 गौरीं श्रियं गुरुं चास्त्रं शक्त्यादिं धर्मकादिकमिति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 53
सर्वभूतदमनी च मदनोन्मादिनी शिवासनं //
21.m:
and Balavikariṇī, Balapramathinī in order,
[Footnote]
1. "prahvī sandhyā tatheśānānugrahāsanamūrtikā" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
2. "durgāṃ giriṃ gaṇam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "durgāṃ śivaṃ gaṇam" in gha.
3. "yajet durgām" is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha and gha.
4. "giriṃ śriyam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "śivaṃ śriyatam" in gha.
5. "gaurīṃ śriyaṃ guruṃ cāstraṃ śaktyādiṃ dharmakādikam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [p. 53]
Sarvabhūtadamanī, and Madanonmādinī, on the seat of Śiva.

21.s:
hāṃ huṃ hāṃ śivamūrtaye sāṅgavaktraṃ śivaṃ yajet /
hauṃ śivāya hāmityādi hāmīśānādivaktrakaṃ //
21.d:
हां हुं हां शिवमूर्तये साङ्गवक्त्रं शिवं यजेत् /
हौं शिवाय हामित्यादि हामीशानादिवक्त्रकं //
21.m: "Hāṃ huṃ hāṃ to the icon of Śiva"—one should worship Śiva with his limbs and faces; / "Hauṃ to Śiva, hām" and so forth; "hām" to the faces beginning with Īśāna;

21.s:
hrīṃ gaurīṃ gaṃ gaṇaḥ śakramukhāś caṇḍīhṛtādikāḥ /
kramātsūryārcane mantrā daṇḍī pūjyaś ca piṅgalaḥ //
21.d:
ह्रीं गौरीं गं गणः शक्रमुखाश् चण्डीहृतादिकाः /
क्रमात्सूर्यार्चने मन्त्रा दण्डी पूज्यश् च पिङ्गलः //
21.m: "hrīṃ" to Gaurī, "gaṃ" to Gaṇa, and those headed by Indra, the heart of Caṇḍī, and the rest. / In order, the mantras in the worship of Sūrya: Daṇḍin and Piṅgala are to be worshipped,

21.s:
uccaiḥśravāścāruṇaś ca prabhūtaṃ vimalaṃ yajet /
sārādhyoparamasukhaṃ(1) skandādyaṃ madhyato yajet //
21.d:
उच्चैःश्रवाश्चारुणश् च प्रभूतं विमलं यजेत् /
साराध्योपरमसुखं(1) स्कन्दाद्यं मध्यतो यजेत् //
21.m: Uccaiḥśravas and Aruṇa; one should worship Prabhūta and Vimala; / one should worship the supreme bliss easily attained, Skanda and the others, in the center;

21.s:
dīptā sūkṣmā jayā bhadrā vibhūtirvimalā tathā /
amoghā vidyutā caiva pūjyātha sarvatomukhī //
21.d:
दीप्ता सूक्ष्मा जया भद्रा विभूतिर्विमला तथा /
अमोघा विद्युता चैव पूज्याथ सर्वतोमुखी //
21.m: Dīptā, Sūkṣmā, Jayā, Bhadrā, Vibhūti, Vimalā, / Amoghā, and Vidyutā; and then Sarvatomukhī is to be worshipped;

21.s:
arkāsanaṃ hi haṃ khaṃ kha solkāyeti ca mūrtikām /
hrāṃ hrīṃ sa sūryāya nama āṃ namo hṛdāya ca //
21.d:
अर्कासनं हि हं खं ख सोल्कायेति च मूर्तिकाम् /
ह्रां ह्रीं स सूर्याय नम आं नमो हृदाय च //
21.m: the seat of Sūrya with "haṃ khaṃ kha solkāya" and the icon; / "Hrāṃ hrīṃ saḥ to Sūrya, namaḥ," and "āṃ namaḥ to the heart,"

21.s:
arkāya śirase tadvadagnīśāsuravāyugān(2) /
bhūrbhuvaḥ svare jvālini śikhā huṃ kavacaṃ smṛtaṃ //
21.d:
अर्काय शिरसे तद्वदग्नीशासुरवायुगान्(2) /
भूर्भुवः स्वरे ज्वालिनि शिखा हुं कवचं स्मृतं //
21.m: likewise "to the Sun, to the head"; those residing in the directions of Agni, Īśa, Asura, and Vāyu; / "bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ, O radiant one," the crest; "huṃ" is stated to be the armor;

21.s:
bhāṃ netraṃ vas tathārkāstraṃ rājñī śaktiś ca niṣkubhā(3) /
somo 'ṅgārakotha budho jīvaḥ śukraḥ śaniḥ kramāt //
21.d:
भां नेत्रं वस् तथार्कास्त्रं राज्ञी शक्तिश् च निष्कुभा(3) /
सोमो ऽङ्गारकोथ बुधो जीवः शुक्रः शनिः क्रमात् //
21.m: "bhāṃ" the eye, "vaḥ" likewise the weapon of the Sun; Rājñī, Śakti, and Niṣkubhā; / Soma, Aṅgāraka, then Budha, Jīva, Śukra, Śani in order,

21.s:
rāhuḥ ketustejaś caṇḍaḥ saṅkṣepādatha pūjanaṃ /
āsanaṃ mūrtaye mūlaṃ hṛdādyaṃ paricārakaḥ //
21.d:
राहुः केतुस्तेजश् चण्डः सङ्क्षेपादथ पूजनं /
आसनं मूर्तये मूलं हृदाद्यं परिचारकः //
21.m: Rāhu, Ketu, and the fierce splendor; now the worship in brief: / the seat, for the icon, the root [mantra], beginning with the heart, the attendant;

21.s:
viṣṇvāsanaṃ viṣṇurmūrteroṃ śrīṃ śrīṃ śrīdharohariḥ /
hrīṃ sarvamūrtimantroyamiti trailokyamohanaḥ //
21.d:
विष्ण्वासनं विष्णुर्मूर्तेरों श्रीं श्रीं श्रीधरोहरिः /
ह्रीं सर्वमूर्तिमन्त्रोयमिति त्रैलोक्यमोहनः //
21.m: the seat of Viṣṇu, Viṣṇu for the icon: "oṃ śrīṃ śrīṃ Śrīdhara Hari, / hrīṃ"—this is the mantra for all icons, enchanting the three worlds;

21.s:
hrīṃ hṛṣīkeśaḥ klīṃ viṣṇuḥ svarair dīrghairhṛdādikaṃ /
samastaiḥ pañcamī pūjā saṅgrāmādau jayādidā //
:n
1 sāvārādhyoparaṃ duḥkhamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 agnisāśrayavāyugāniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / arkāya śirase
tadvadagnijāyāyutañca taditi ṅa,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 śaktiś ca nirgatā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 54
21.d:
ह्रीं हृषीकेशः क्लीं विष्णुः स्वरैर् दीर्घैर्हृदादिकं /
समस्तैः पञ्चमी पूजा सङ्ग्रामादौ जयादिदा //
:न्
1 सावाराध्योपरं दुःखमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 अग्निसाश्रयवायुगानिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / अर्काय शिरसे
तद्वदग्निजायायुतञ्च तदिति ङ,चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 शक्तिश् च निर्गता इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 54
21.m:
"hrīṃ Hṛṣīkeśa, klīṃ Viṣṇu," with the long vowels for the heart and other limbs; / the fifth worship with all of them grants victory and the like in battle and elsewhere.
[Footnote]
1. "sāvārādhyoparaṃ duḥkham" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "agnisāśrayavāyugān" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "arkāya śirase tadvadagnijāyāyutañca tat" in ṅa.
3. "śaktiś ca nirgatā" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / [p. 54]

21.s:
cakraṃ gadāṃ kramācchaṅkhaṃ muṣalaṃ khaḍgaśārṅgakam /
pāśāṅkuśau ca śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ vanamālayā //
21.d:
चक्रं गदां क्रमाच्छङ्खं मुषलं खड्गशार्ङ्गकम् /
पाशाङ्कुशौ च श्रीवत्सं कौस्तुभं वनमालया //
21.m: The discus, club, in order the conch, pestle, sword, and bow Śārṅga, / and the noose and goad, the Śrīvatsa mark, the Kaustubha jewel, together with the forest garland;

21.s:
śrīṃ śrīrmahālakṣmītārkṣyo gururindrādayo 'rcanam /
sarasvatyāsanaṃ mūrtirauṃ hrīṃ dadhī sarasvatī //
21.d:
श्रीं श्रीर्महालक्ष्मीतार्क्ष्यो गुरुरिन्द्रादयो ऽर्चनम् /
सरस्वत्यासनं मूर्तिरौं ह्रीं दधी सरस्वती //
21.m: Śrīṃ, Śrī, Mahālakṣmī, Garuḍa, the guru, Indra and the other [guardians], are worshiped. / Sarasvatī's seat and icon: auṃ hrīṃ dadhī Sarasvatī;

21.s:
hṛdādyā lakṣmīrmedhā ca kalātuṣṭiś ca puṣṭikā /
gaurī prabhāmatī durgā gaṇo guruś ca kṣetrapaḥ //
21.d:
हृदाद्या लक्ष्मीर्मेधा च कलातुष्टिश् च पुष्टिका /
गौरी प्रभामती दुर्गा गणो गुरुश् च क्षेत्रपः //
21.m: The deities of the heart and other limbs, Lakṣmī, Medhā, Kalā, Tuṣṭi, and Puṣṭi, / Gaurī, Prabhāvatī, Durgā, Gaṇapati, the guru, and Kṣetrapāla;

21.s:
tathā gaṃ gaṇapataye ca hrīṃ gauryai ca śrīṃ śriyai /
hrīṃ tvaritāyai hrīṃ sau tripurā(1) caturthyantanamontakāḥ //
21.d:
तथा गं गणपतये च ह्रीं गौर्यै च श्रीं श्रियै /
ह्रीं त्वरितायै ह्रीं सौ त्रिपुरा(1) चतुर्थ्यन्तनमोन्तकाः //
21.m: Likewise, gaṃ to Gaṇapati, hrīṃ to Gaurī, and śrīṃ to Śrī, / hrīṃ to Tvaritā, hrīṃ sauḥ to Tripurā, ending with the dative and namas;

21.s:
praṇavādyāś ca nāmādyamakṣaraṃ vindusaṃyutaṃ /
oṃ yutaṃ vā sarvamantrapūjanājjapataḥ smṛtāḥ //
21.d:
प्रणवाद्याश् च नामाद्यमक्षरं विन्दुसंयुतं /
ओं युतं वा सर्वमन्त्रपूजनाज्जपतः स्मृताः //
21.m: Beginning with praṇava and the first letter of the name, joined with the bindu, / or combined with oṃ, [these] are handed down from the worship and recitation of all mantras.

21.s:
homāttilaghṛtādyaiś ca dharmakāmārthamokṣadāḥ /
pūjāmantrān paṭhedyastu bhuktabhogo divaṃ vrajet //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye vāsudevādipūjākathanaṃ nāma
ekaviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
snānavidhikathanaṃ
21.d:
होमात्तिलघृताद्यैश् च धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदाः /
पूजामन्त्रान् पठेद्यस्तु भुक्तभोगो दिवं व्रजेत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये वासुदेवादिपूजाकथनं नाम
एकविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ द्वाविंशो ऽध्यायः
स्नानविधिकथनं
21.m:
Through fire oblations of sesame seeds, clarified butter, and the like, they grant duty, pleasure, wealth, and liberation. / Whoever recites these mantras of worship, having enjoyed worldly pleasures, goes to heaven.
Thus ends the twenty-first chapter in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa, the Āgneya, entitled ‘The Account of the Worship of Vāsudeva and Others’.
Now, the twenty-second chapter.
The account of the rules for bathing.

22.s:
nārada uvāca
vakṣye snānaṃ kriyādyarthaṃ nṛsiṃhena tu mṛttikāṃ /
gṛhītvā tāṃ dvidhā kṛtvā manaḥsnānamathaikayā //
22.d:
नारद उवाच
वक्ष्ये स्नानं क्रियाद्यर्थं नृसिंहेन तु मृत्तिकां /
गृहीत्वा तां द्विधा कृत्वा मनःस्नानमथैकया //
22.m: Nārada said: / I shall explain the bath for rites and other duties. Having taken clay with the Nṛsiṃha [mantra], / and dividing it into two portions, one first performs the mental bath with one portion.

22.s:
nimajyācamya vinyasya siṃhena kṛtarakṣakaḥ(2) /
:n
1 hrīṃ tvaritāyai, hrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ sau tripurā iti kha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 kṛtarakṣaṇa iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 55
vidhisnānaṃ tataḥ kuryāt prāṇāyāmapuraḥsaraṃ //
22.d:
निमज्याचम्य विन्यस्य सिंहेन कृतरक्षकः(2) /
:न्
1 ह्रीं त्वरितायै, ह्रीं ऐं क्लीं सौ त्रिपुरा इति ख,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 कृतरक्षण इति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 55
विधिस्नानं ततः कुर्यात् प्राणायामपुरःसरं //
22.m:
Having submerged oneself, sipped water, performed ritual deposition, and protected oneself with the Narasiṃha [mantra],
[Footnote]
1. In the manuscript marked kha, the reading is ‘hrīṃ tvaritāyai hrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ sau tripurā’.
2. In the manuscript marked gha, the reading is ‘kṛtarakṣaṇaḥ’.
One should then perform the prescribed ritual bath, preceded by breath control.

22.s:
hṛdi dhyāyan harijñānaṃ(1) mantreṇāṣṭākṣareṇa hi /
tridhā pāṇitale mṛtsnāṃ digbandhaṃ siṃhajaptataḥ //
22.d:
हृदि ध्यायन् हरिज्ञानं(1) मन्त्रेणाष्टाक्षरेण हि /
त्रिधा पाणितले मृत्स्नां दिग्बन्धं सिंहजप्ततः //
22.m: Meditating in one's heart on Hari with knowledge, indeed using the eight-syllable mantra, / [placing] the clay in threefold division on the palm, one secures the directions with [the clay] consecrated by the Narasiṃha [mantra].

22.s:
vāsadevaprajaptena tīrthaṃ saṅkalpya cālabhet /
gātraṃ vedādinā mantraiḥ sammārjyārādhya mūrtinā //
22.d:
वासदेवप्रजप्तेन तीर्थं सङ्कल्प्य चालभेत् /
गात्रं वेदादिना मन्त्रैः सम्मार्ज्याराध्य मूर्तिना //
22.m: With the sacred ford invoked through [water] consecrated by the Vāsudeva [mantra], one touches [the water]. / One should wipe the body with the mantras starting with the Vedas, and worship with the mūrti-mantra.

22.s:
kṛtvāghamarṣaṇaṃ vastraṃ paridhāya samācaret /
vinyasya mantrair dvirmārjya pāṇisthaṃ jalameva ca //
22.d:
कृत्वाघमर्षणं वस्त्रं परिधाय समाचरेत् /
विन्यस्य मन्त्रैर् द्विर्मार्ज्य पाणिस्थं जलमेव च //
22.m: Having performed the sin-eradicating rite (aghamarṣaṇa) and put on dry garments, one should act: / performing ritual deposition with mantras, wiping oneself twice, and then taking water in the hand,

22.s:
nārāyaṇena saṃyamya vāyumāghrāya cotsṛjet /
jalaṃ dhyāyan hariṃ paścāddatvārghyaṃ dvādaśākṣaraṃ //
22.d:
नारायणेन संयम्य वायुमाघ्राय चोत्सृजेत् /
जलं ध्यायन् हरिं पश्चाद्दत्वार्घ्यं द्वादशाक्षरं //
22.m: Restraining one's breath with the Nārāyaṇa [mantra], smelling the water, one should release it. / Meditating on Hari in the water and then offering arghya water, one should recite the twelve-syllable [mantra]

22.s:
japtvānyāñchataśastasya yogapīṭhāditaḥ kramāt /
mantrān dikpālaparyantānṛṣīn pitṛgaṇānapi //
22.d:
जप्त्वान्याञ्छतशस्तस्य योगपीठादितः क्रमात् /
मन्त्रान् दिक्पालपर्यन्तानृषीन् पितृगणानपि //
22.m: Hundreds of times, and other mantras in sequence, beginning with his yogapīṭha / down to the guardians of the directions, the sages, and the ancestral spirits (pitṛs),

22.s:
manuṣyān sarvabhūtāni sthāvarāntānyathāvaset /
nyasya cāṅgāni saṃhṛtya mantrānyāgagṛhaṃ vrajet //
evamanyāsu pūjāsu mūlādyaiḥ snānamācaret //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye snānavidhikathanaṃ nāma
dvāviṃśodhyāyaḥ
:ś atha trayoviṃśodhyāyaḥ
pūjāvidhikathanaṃ
22.d:
मनुष्यान् सर्वभूतानि स्थावरान्तान्यथावसेत् /
न्यस्य चाङ्गानि संहृत्य मन्त्रान्यागगृहं व्रजेत् //
एवमन्यासु पूजासु मूलाद्यैः स्नानमाचरेत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये स्नानविधिकथनं नाम
द्वाविंशोध्यायः
:श् अथ त्रयोविंशोध्यायः
पूजाविधिकथनं
22.m:
Men, and all living beings down to the immovable. / Having deposited and withdrawn the limb-mantras, one should proceed to the sacrificial chamber. / In this way, during other worship rituals, one should perform the bath using the mūlamantra and other mantras.
Thus ends the twenty-second chapter in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa, the Āgneya, entitled ‘The Account of the Rules for Bathing’.
Now, the twenty-third chapter.
The account of the rules for worship.

23.s:
nārada uvāca
vakṣye pūjāvidhiṃ viprā yat kṛtvā sarvamāpnuyāt /
prakṣālitāṅghrirācamya vāgyataḥ kṛtarakṣakaḥ //
:n
1 dhyāyaṃ hariṃ devamiti gha.cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 56
23.d:
नारद उवाच
वक्ष्ये पूजाविधिं विप्रा यत् कृत्वा सर्वमाप्नुयात् /
प्रक्षालिताङ्घ्रिराचम्य वाग्यतः कृतरक्षकः //
:न्
1 ध्यायं हरिं देवमिति घ.चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 56
23.m:
Nārada said: / O Brahmins, I shall explain the procedure of worship by performing which one obtains everything. / Having washed the feet, sipped water, restrained speech, and protected oneself,
[Footnote]
1. In the manuscript marked gha, the reading is ‘dhyāyaṃ hariṃ devam’.

23.s:
prāṅmukhaḥ svastikaṃ baddhvā padmādyaparameva ca /
yaṃ vījaṃ nābhimadhyasthaṃ dhūmraṃ caṇḍānilātmakaṃ //
23.d:
प्राङ्मुखः स्वस्तिकं बद्ध्वा पद्माद्यपरमेव च /
यं वीजं नाभिमध्यस्थं धूम्रं चण्डानिलात्मकं //
23.m: Facing east, assuming the svastika posture, or the lotus posture and the like, / [one contemplates] the seed-syllable ‘yaṃ’ situated in the center of the navel, smoky and having the nature of a violent wind;

23.s:
viśeṣayedaśeṣantu(1) dhyāyet kāyāttu kalmaṣaṃ /
kṣauṃ hṛtpaṅkajamadhyasthaṃ vījaṃ tejonidhiṃ smaran //
23.d:
विशेषयेदशेषन्तु(1) ध्यायेत् कायात्तु कल्मषं /
क्षौं हृत्पङ्कजमध्यस्थं वीजं तेजोनिधिं स्मरन् //
23.m: One should dry up completely and contemplate the taint [expelled] from the body. / Remembering the seed-syllable ‘kṣauṃ’ situated in the center of the heart-lotus, an ocean of light,

23.s:
adhordhvatiryaggābhistu jvālābhiḥ kalmaṣaṃ dahet /
śaśāṅkākṛtivaddhyāyedambarasthaṃ sudhāmbubhiḥ //
23.d:
अधोर्ध्वतिर्यग्गाभिस्तु ज्वालाभिः कल्मषं दहेत् /
शशाङ्काकृतिवद्ध्यायेदम्बरस्थं सुधाम्बुभिः //
23.m: One burns away the taint with flames extending downward, upward, and horizontally. / One should meditate on [the seed-syllable] situated in the sky, resembling the moon, with nectar-waters

23.s:
hṛtpadmavyāpibhirdehaṃ svakamāplāvayetsudhīḥ(2) /
susumnāyonimārgeṇa sarvanāḍīvisarpibhiḥ //
23.d:
हृत्पद्मव्यापिभिर्देहं स्वकमाप्लावयेत्सुधीः(2) /
सुसुम्नायोनिमार्गेण सर्वनाडीविसर्पिभिः //
23.m: Pervading the heart-lotus; the wise practitioner should bathe his own body / through the pathway of the suṣumnā origin, flowing through all the channels (nāḍīs).

23.s:
śodhayitvā nyasettattvaṃ karaśuddhirathāstrakaṃ /
vyāpakaṃ hastayorādau dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhatoṅgakaṃ //
23.d:
शोधयित्वा न्यसेत्तत्त्वं करशुद्धिरथास्त्रकं /
व्यापकं हस्तयोरादौ दक्षिणाङ्गुष्ठतोङ्गकं //
23.m: Having purified it, one should deposit the cosmic principles. Then comes purification of the hands, and then the astra-mantra; / first the pervasive ritual deposition on the hands, then on the limbs beginning from the right thumb.

23.s:
mūlaṃ dehe dvādaśāṅgaṃ nyasenmantrair dviṣaṭkakaiḥ /
hṛdayaṃ ca śiraś caiva śikhā varmāstralocane //
23.d:
मूलं देहे द्वादशाङ्गं न्यसेन्मन्त्रैर् द्विषट्ककैः /
हृदयं च शिरश् चैव शिखा वर्मास्त्रलोचने //
23.m: One should deposit the twelve-limbed mūlamantra on the body with the twelve mantras: / the heart, the head, the tuft, the armor, the astra-weapon, the eyes,

23.s:
udaraṃ ca tathā pṛṣṭhaṃ bāhurujānupādakaṃ /
mudrāṃ dattvā smaret viṣṇuṃ japtvāṣṭaśatamarcayet //
23.d:
उदरं च तथा पृष्ठं बाहुरुजानुपादकं /
मुद्रां दत्त्वा स्मरेत् विष्णुं जप्त्वाष्टशतमर्चयेत् //
23.m: The belly, the back, the arms, the thighs, the knees, and the feet. / Presenting the ritual gesture, meditating on Viṣṇu, and reciting [the mantra] one hundred and eight times, one should worship.

23.s:
vāme tu vardhanīṃ nyasya pūjādravyaṃ tu dakṣiṇe /
prakṣālyāstreṇa cārghyeṇa gandhapuṣpānvite nyaset //
23.d:
वामे तु वर्धनीं न्यस्य पूजाद्रव्यं तु दक्षिणे /
प्रक्षाल्यास्त्रेण चार्घ्येण गन्धपुष्पान्विते न्यसेत् //
23.m: Placing the vardhanī pitcher on the left and the worship implements on the right, / washing them with the astra-mantra and arghya water, one should deposit them accompanied by fragrant sandal-paste and flowers.

23.s:
caitanyaṃ sarvagaṃ jyotiraṣṭajaptena vāriṇā /
phaḍantena tu saṃsicya haste dhyātvā hariṃ pare(3) //
23.d:
चैतन्यं सर्वगं ज्योतिरष्टजप्तेन वारिणा /
फडन्तेन तु संसिच्य हस्ते ध्यात्वा हरिं परे(3) //
23.m: Sprinkling with water consecrated eight times with the mantra ending in phaṭ, / [which embodies] consciousness, all-pervading light, and meditating on Hari in one's hand, on the supreme [pedestal],

23.s:
dharmaṃ jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ vahnidiṅmukhāḥ /
adharmādīni gātrāṇi pūrvādau yogapīṭhake //
23.d:
धर्मं ज्ञानं च वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं वह्निदिङ्मुखाः /
अधर्मादीनि गात्राणि पूर्वादौ योगपीठके //
23.m: Dharma, knowledge, dispassion, and sovereign power, facing the south-east and other directions; / unrighteousness and the rest as the sides, starting from the east on the yogapīṭha.

23.s:
kūrmaṃ pīṭhe hy anantañca yamaṃ(4) sūryādimaṇḍalaṃ /
:n
1 viśoṣayedaśeṣantu iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 svakāmān dāhayet sudhīḥ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
svakamāhlādayet sudhīriti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 sthalaṃ tena tu saṃsicya haste dhyātvā hariṃ paṭhediti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 padmamiti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
:p 57
vimalādyāḥ keśarasthānugrahā karṇikā sthitā //
23.d:
कूर्मं पीठे ह्य् अनन्तञ्च यमं(4) सूर्यादिमण्डलं /
:न्
1 विशोषयेदशेषन्तु इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 स्वकामान् दाहयेत् सुधीः इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
स्वकमाह्लादयेत् सुधीरिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 स्थलं तेन तु संसिच्य हस्ते ध्यात्वा हरिं पठेदिति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 पद्ममिति ख, ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
:प् 57
विमलाद्याः केशरस्थानुग्रहा कर्णिका स्थिता //
23.m:
On the seat [one worships] Kūrma, Ananta, Yama, and the orb of the sun and other planets;
[Footnote]
1. In the manuscript marked ṅa, the reading is ‘viśoṣayedaśeṣantu’.
2. In the manuscript marked kha, the reading is ‘svakāmān dāhayet sudhīḥ’; in the manuscript marked ṅa, ‘svakamāhlādayet sudhīḥ’.
3. In the manuscript marked ṅa, the reading is ‘sthalaṃ tena tu saṃsicya haste dhyātvā hariṃ paṭhet’.
4. In the three manuscripts marked kha, ga, and ṅa, the reading is ‘padmam’.
Vimalā and the other [śaktis] reside on the filaments, and Anugrahā resides on the pericarp.

23.s:
pūrvaṃ svahṛdaye dhyātvā āvāhyārcaiś ca maṇḍale /
arghyaṃ pādyaṃ tathācāmaṃ madhuparkaṃ punaś ca tat //
23.d:
पूर्वं स्वहृदये ध्यात्वा आवाह्यार्चैश् च मण्डले /
अर्घ्यं पाद्यं तथाचामं मधुपर्कं पुनश् च तत् //
23.m: Having first meditated [on him] in one's own heart, invoking him with worship rites into the maṇḍala, / [one offers] arghya water, water for washing the feet, water for sipping, madhuparka, and again that [water for sipping];

23.s:
snānaṃ vastropavītañca bhūṣaṇaṃ gandhapuṣpakaṃ /
dhūpadīpanair vedyāni puṇḍarīkākṣavidyayā //
23.d:
स्नानं वस्त्रोपवीतञ्च भूषणं गन्धपुष्पकं /
धूपदीपनैर् वेद्यानि पुण्डरीकाक्षविद्यया //
23.m: Bath, garments, sacred thread, ornaments, fragrant sandal-paste and flowers, / incense, lamps, and food offerings, using the Puṇḍarīkākṣa mantra.

23.s:
yajedaṅgāni pūrvādau dvāri pūrve pareṇḍajaṃ /
dakṣe cakraṃ gadāṃ saumye koṇe śaṅkhaṃ dhanurnyaset //
23.d:
यजेदङ्गानि पूर्वादौ द्वारि पूर्वे परेण्डजं /
दक्षे चक्रं गदां सौम्ये कोणे शङ्खं धनुर्न्यसेत् //
23.m: One should worship the limbs starting in the east; at the eastern gate, the bird Garuḍa; / on the right, the discus; on the north, the club; at the corner, one should deposit the conch and bow;

23.s:
devasya vāmato dakṣe ceṣudhī khaḍgameva ca /
vāme carma śriyaṃ(1) dakṣe puṣṭiṃ vāmegrato nyaset //
23.d:
देवस्य वामतो दक्षे चेषुधी खड्गमेव च /
वामे चर्म श्रियं(1) दक्षे पुष्टिं वामेग्रतो न्यसेत् //
23.m: To the left and right of the deity, quivers and the sword; / on the left, the shield; on the right, Śrī; on the left, Puṣṭi; and in front,

23.s:
vanamālāñca śrīvatsakaustubhau dikpatīnvahiḥ /
svamantraiḥ pūjayet sarvān viṣṇurarghovasānataḥ(2) //
23.d:
वनमालाञ्च श्रीवत्सकौस्तुभौ दिक्पतीन्वहिः /
स्वमन्त्रैः पूजयेत् सर्वान् विष्णुरर्घोवसानतः(2) //
23.m: The forest garland, the Śrīvatsa mark, the Kaustubha jewel, and the regents of the directions outside. / One should worship them all with their own mantras, Viṣṇu [being worshiped] until the conclusion of the arghya offering.

23.s:
vyastena ca samastena aṅgair vījena vai yajet /
japtvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya stuttvārdhyañca samarpya ca //
23.d:
व्यस्तेन च समस्तेन अङ्गैर् वीजेन वै यजेत् /
जप्त्वा प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य स्तुत्त्वार्ध्यञ्च समर्प्य च //
23.m: One should worship with the mantra both divided and whole, with the limbs, and with the seed-syllable. / Having recited [the mantra], circumambulated clockwise, praised him, and offered arghya water,

23.s:
hṛdaye vinyaseddhyātvā ahaṃ brahma haristviti /
āgacchāvāhane yojyaṃ kṣamasveti visarjane //
23.d:
हृदये विन्यसेद्ध्यात्वा अहं ब्रह्म हरिस्त्विति /
आगच्छावाहने योज्यं क्षमस्वेति विसर्जने //
23.m: One should deposit him in the heart, contemplating: ‘I am indeed Brahman, Hari.’ / ‘Come’ is to be employed in invocation; ‘Pardon’ in dismissal.

23.s:
evamaṣṭākṣarādyaiś ca pūjāṃ kṛtvā vimuktibhāk /
ekamūrtyarcanaṃ proktaṃ navavyūhārcanaṃ śṛṇu //
23.d:
एवमष्टाक्षराद्यैश् च पूजां कृत्वा विमुक्तिभाक् /
एकमूर्त्यर्चनं प्रोक्तं नवव्यूहार्चनं शृणु //
23.m: Having thus performed worship with the eight-syllable mantra and others, one attains liberation. / The worship of a single mūrti has been declared; now listen to the worship of the nine vyūhas:

23.s:
aṅguṣṭhakadvaye nyasya vāsudevaṃ balādikān /
tarjanyādau śarīretha śirolalāṭavaktrake //
23.d:
अङ्गुष्ठकद्वये न्यस्य वासुदेवं बलादिकान् /
तर्जन्यादौ शरीरेथ शिरोललाटवक्त्रके //
23.m: Depositing Vāsudeva on the two thumbs, Baladeva and the others / on the index fingers and the rest; then on the body, on the head, forehead, and mouth,

23.s:
hṛnnābhiguhyajānvaṅghrau madhye pūrvādikaṃ yajet(3) /
ekapīṭhaṃ navavyūhaṃ navapīṭhañca pūrvavat //
:n
1 vāme varma śriyamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 asmallabdhapustakeṣu viṣṇurarghovasānata iti viṣṇāvarghau ca
mānataḥ iti ca pāṭho vartate / ayansvasamīcīna iva pratibhāti
viṣṇumarghyāsanādibhiriti tu yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ
3 madhyagulphāditaḥ pisphaca iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 58
23.d:
हृन्नाभिगुह्यजान्वङ्घ्रौ मध्ये पूर्वादिकं यजेत्(3) /
एकपीठं नवव्यूहं नवपीठञ्च पूर्ववत् //
:न्
1 वामे वर्म श्रियमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 अस्मल्लब्धपुस्तकेषु विष्णुरर्घोवसानत इति विष्णावर्घौ च
मानतः इति च पाठो वर्तते / अयन्स्वसमीचीन इव प्रतिभाति
विष्णुमर्घ्यासनादिभिरिति तु युक्तः पाठः
3 मध्यगुल्फादितः पिस्फच इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 58
23.m:
On the heart, navel, private parts, knees, and feet, one should worship in the center and starting from the east; / one may worship the nine vyūhas on a single seat or on nine seats as described before.
[Footnote]
1. In the manuscript marked kha, the reading is ‘vāme varma śriyam’.
2 In the manuscripts obtained by us, there is the reading "viṣṇurarghovasānataḥ" and "viṣṇāvarghau ca mānataḥ". This appears rather improper; the reading "viṣṇumarghyāsanādibhiḥ", however, is suitable.
3 The manuscript marked "ṅa" reads "madhyagulphāditaḥ pisphacaḥ".

23.s:
navābje navamūrtyā ca navavyūhañca pūrvavat /
iṣṭaṃ madhye tataḥ sthāne vāsudevañca pūjayet //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye ādimūrtyādipūjāvidhirnāma
trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
kuṇḍanirmāṇādividhiḥ
23.d:
नवाब्जे नवमूर्त्या च नवव्यूहञ्च पूर्ववत् /
इष्टं मध्ये ततः स्थाने वासुदेवञ्च पूजयेत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये आदिमूर्त्यादिपूजाविधिर्नाम
त्रयोविंशो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ चतुर्विंशो ऽध्यायः
कुण्डनिर्माणादिविधिः
23.m:
In the nine-lotus, [one should worship] with the nine icons and the nine emanations as before. / Then, in the center, in that place, one should worship Vāsudeva.
Thus ends the twenty-third chapter, named 'The Rule for Worshiping the Primeval Icon and Others', in the Ādi-Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now, the twenty-fourth chapter.
The Rule for the Construction of Fire-pits and Related Rites

24.s:
nārada uvāca
agnikāryaṃ pravakṣyāmi yena syātsarvakāmabhāk /
caturabhyadhikaṃ viṃśamaṅgulaṃ caturasrakaṃ //
24.d:
नारद उवाच
अग्निकार्यं प्रवक्ष्यामि येन स्यात्सर्वकामभाक् /
चतुरभ्यधिकं विंशमङ्गुलं चतुरस्रकं //
24.m: Nārada said: / I shall explain the fire-rite by which one attains all desires: / a square of twenty-four finger-breadths.

24.s:
sūtreṇa sūtrayitvā tu kṣetraṃ tāvat khanetsamaṃ /
khātasya mekhalā kāryā tyaktvā caivāṅguladvayaṃ //
24.d:
सूत्रेण सूत्रयित्वा तु क्षेत्रं तावत् खनेत्समं /
खातस्य मेखला कार्या त्यक्त्वा चैवाङ्गुलद्वयं //
24.m: Having measured the area with a cord, one should dig it evenly to that extent. / Leaving [a border of] two finger-breadths, the belt of the excavated [pit] is to be made.

24.s:
sattvādisañjñā(1) pūrvāśā dvādaśāṅgulamucchritā /
aṣṭāṅgulā dvyaṅulātha caturaṅgulavistṛtā //
24.d:
सत्त्वादिसञ्ज्ञा(1) पूर्वाशा द्वादशाङ्गुलमुच्छ्रिता /
अष्टाङ्गुला द्व्यङुलाथ चतुरङ्गुलविस्तृता //
24.m: Designated as sattva and the like, [the tiers] in the eastern direction are twelve finger-breadths high, / eight finger-breadths, [and] two finger-breadths; and [each is] four finger-breadths wide.

24.s:
yonirdaśāṅgulā ramyā ṣaṭcaturdvyaṅgulāgragā /
kramānnimnā tu kartavyā paścimāśāvyavasthitā //
24.d:
योनिर्दशाङ्गुला रम्या षट्चतुर्द्व्यङ्गुलाग्रगा /
क्रमान्निम्ना तु कर्तव्या पश्चिमाशाव्यवस्थिता //
24.m: The beautiful yoni is ten finger-breadths [wide], its tip measuring six, four, and two finger-breadths; / it should be made gradually sloping and situated in the western direction.

24.s:
aśvatthapatrasadṛśī kiñcit kuṇḍe niveśitā /
turyāṅgulāyatā nālaṃ pañcadaśāṅgulāyataṃ //
24.d:
अश्वत्थपत्रसदृशी किञ्चित् कुण्डे निवेशिता /
तुर्याङ्गुलायता नालं पञ्चदशाङ्गुलायतं //
24.m: Resembling an aśvattha leaf, it is placed slightly into the fire-pit; / it extends four finger-breadths, and its neck extends fifteen finger-breadths.

24.s:
mūlantu tryaṅgulaṃ(2) yonyā agraṃ tasyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ /
lakṣaṇañcaikahastasya dviguṇaṃ dvikarādiṣu //
24.d:
मूलन्तु त्र्यङ्गुलं(2) योन्या अग्रं तस्याः षडङ्गुलं /
लक्षणञ्चैकहस्तस्य द्विगुणं द्विकरादिषु //
24.m: The base of the yoni is three finger-breadths; its tip is six finger-breadths. / This is the characteristic of [a pit of] one cubit; in those of two cubits and so forth, it is doubled.

24.s:
ekatrimekhalaṃ kuṇḍaṃ vartulādi vadāmyahaṃ /
:n
1 sadmādisañjñā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 malantu dvyaṅgulamiti ga,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 59
kuṇḍārdhe tu sthitaṃ sūtraṃ koṇe yadatiricyate //
24.d:
एकत्रिमेखलं कुण्डं वर्तुलादि वदाम्यहं /
:न्
1 सद्मादिसञ्ज्ञा इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 मलन्तु द्व्यङ्गुलमिति ग,चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 59
कुण्डार्धे तु स्थितं सूत्रं कोणे यदतिरिच्यते //
24.m:
I shall describe the fire-pit with one or three belts, circular and of other shapes.
[Footnotes]
1 The manuscript marked "kha" reads "sadmādisañjñā".
2 The manuscript marked "ga" reads "malantu dvyaṅgulam".
A cord placed across half of the fire-pit, which projects beyond the corner—

24.s:
tadardhaṃ diśi saṃsthāpya bhrāmitaṃ vartulaṃ bhavet /
kuṇḍārdhaṃ koṇabhāgārdhaṃ diśiścottarato vahiḥ //
24.d:
तदर्धं दिशि संस्थाप्य भ्रामितं वर्तुलं भवेत् /
कुण्डार्धं कोणभागार्धं दिशिश्चोत्तरतो वहिः //
24.m: having placed half of that in the [cardinal] direction and rotated it, a circle will be produced. / Placing half the fire-pit plus half the corner segment outside in the northern direction,

24.s:
pūrvapaścimato yatnāllāñchayitvā tu madhyataḥ /
saṃsthāpya bhrāmitaṃ kuṇḍamardhacandraṃ bhavet śubhaṃ //
24.d:
पूर्वपश्चिमतो यत्नाल्लाञ्छयित्वा तु मध्यतः /
संस्थाप्य भ्रामितं कुण्डमर्धचन्द्रं भवेत् शुभं //
24.m: carefully marking it from east to west, and having fixed and rotated it from the center, / an auspicious crescent-shaped fire-pit will be produced.

24.s:
padmākāre dalāni syurmekhalānāntu vartule /
bāhudaṇḍapramāṇantu homārthaṃ kārayet srucaṃ //
24.d:
पद्माकारे दलानि स्युर्मेखलानान्तु वर्तुले /
बाहुदण्डप्रमाणन्तु होमार्थं कारयेत् स्रुचं //
24.m: In a lotus-shaped [pit] there should be petals, and in a circular one [there should be] belts. / For the fire oblation, one should make a sruc measuring the length of an arm.

24.s:
saptapañcāṅgulaṃ vāpi caturasrantu kārayet /
tribhāgena bhavedgartaṃ madhye vṛttaṃ suśobhanam //
24.d:
सप्तपञ्चाङ्गुलं वापि चतुरस्रन्तु कारयेत् /
त्रिभागेन भवेद्गर्तं मध्ये वृत्तं सुशोभनम् //
24.m: Or one may make it square, measuring seven or five finger-breadths. / The hollow should occupy one-third, and a very beautiful circle should be in the middle.

24.s:
tiryagūrdhvaṃ samaṃ khātādvahirardhantu śodhayet /
aṅgulasya caturthāṃśaṃ śeṣārdhārdhaṃ tathāntataḥ //
24.d:
तिर्यगूर्ध्वं समं खाताद्वहिरर्धन्तु शोधयेत् /
अङ्गुलस्य चतुर्थांशं शेषार्धार्धं तथान्ततः //
24.m: Level crosswise and upward, outside the excavated [hollow] one should clear half [the surface]; / one-fourth of a finger-breadth, and half of the remaining half at the edge.

24.s:
khātasya mekhalāṃ ramyāṃ śeṣārdhena tu kārayet /
kaṇṭhaṃ tribhāgavistāraṃ aṅguṣṭhakasamāyataṃ //
24.d:
खातस्य मेखलां रम्यां शेषार्धेन तु कारयेत् /
कण्ठं त्रिभागविस्तारं अङ्गुष्ठकसमायतं //
24.m: With the remaining half, one should make a charming belt for the excavated hollow. / The neck is one-third in width and equal in length to a thumb;

24.s:
sārdhamaṅguṣṭhakaṃ vā syāttadagre tu mukhaṃ bhavet /
caturaṅgulavistāraṃ pañcāṅgulamathāpi vā //
24.d:
सार्धमङ्गुष्ठकं वा स्यात्तदग्रे तु मुखं भवेत् /
चतुरङ्गुलविस्तारं पञ्चाङ्गुलमथापि वा //
24.m: or it may be one and a half thumbs; at its tip there should be a mouth, / four finger-breadths in width, or even five finger-breadths.

24.s:
trikaṃ dvyaṅgulakaṃ tat syānmadhyantasya suśobhanam /
āyāmastatsamastasya madhyanimnaḥ suśobhanaḥ //
24.d:
त्रिकं द्व्यङ्गुलकं तत् स्यान्मध्यन्तस्य सुशोभनम् /
आयामस्तत्समस्तस्य मध्यनिम्नः सुशोभनः //
24.m: It should be three or two finger-breadths; its middle is very handsome. / Its entire length should be equal to it, depressed and very handsome in the middle.

24.s:
śuṣiraṃ kaṇṭhadeśe syādviśed yāvat kanīyasī /
śeṣakuṇḍantu kartavyaṃ yathāruci vicitritaṃ //
24.d:
शुषिरं कण्ठदेशे स्याद्विशेद् यावत् कनीयसी /
शेषकुण्डन्तु कर्तव्यं यथारुचि विचित्रितं //
24.m: In the region of the neck there should be a cavity into which the little finger can enter. / The remainder of the fire-pit should be made decorated according to one's taste.

24.s:
sruvantu hastamātraṃ syāddaṇḍakena samanvitaṃ (1) /
vaṭukaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ(2) vṛttaṃ kartavyantu suśobhanaṃ //
:n
1 kuṇḍakena samanvitamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 kaṇṭhakaṃ dvyaṅgulamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ candrābhaṃ
dvyaṅgulamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 60
24.d:
स्रुवन्तु हस्तमात्रं स्याद्दण्डकेन समन्वितं (1) /
वटुकं द्व्यङ्गुलं(2) वृत्तं कर्तव्यन्तु सुशोभनं //
:न्
1 कुण्डकेन समन्वितमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 कण्ठकं द्व्यङ्गुलमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः चन्द्राभं
द्व्यङ्गुलमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 60
24.m:
The sruva should measure one cubit and be provided with a handle. / The cup should be made circular, two finger-breadths [wide], and very handsome,
1 The manuscript marked "kha" reads "kuṇḍakena samanvitam".
2 The manuscript marked "kha" reads "kaṇṭhakaṃ dvyaṅgulam"; the manuscript marked "ṅa" reads "candrābhaṃ dvyaṅgulam".

24.s:
gopadantu yathā magnamalpapaṅke tathā bhavet /
upalipya likhedrekhāmaṅgulāṃ vajranāsikāṃ(1) //
24.d:
गोपदन्तु यथा मग्नमल्पपङ्के तथा भवेत् /
उपलिप्य लिखेद्रेखामङ्गुलां वज्रनासिकां(1) //
24.m: such as a cow's footprint sunk into shallow mud would be. / Having smeared [the ground], one should draw lines a finger-breadth [wide] with the tip of a vajra.

24.s:
saumyāgrā prathamā tasyāṃ rekhe pūrvamukhe tayoḥ /
madhye tisras tathā kuryāddakṣiṇādikrameṇa tu //
24.d:
सौम्याग्रा प्रथमा तस्यां रेखे पूर्वमुखे तयोः /
मध्ये तिस्रस् तथा कुर्याद्दक्षिणादिक्रमेण तु //
24.m: The first of these points north; [there are] two lines facing east. / Between them, one should likewise make three, in sequence beginning with the south.

24.s:
evamullikhya cābhyukṣya praṇavena tu mantravit /
viṣṭaraṃ kalpayettena tasmin śaktintu vaiṣṇavīṃ //
24.d:
एवमुल्लिख्य चाभ्युक्ष्य प्रणवेन तु मन्त्रवित् /
विष्टरं कल्पयेत्तेन तस्मिन् शक्तिन्तु वैष्णवीं //
24.m: Having thus inscribed and sprinkled [the area] with the praṇava, the knower of mantras / should prepare a seat with it, and in that, [visualize] the Vaiṣṇava power.

24.s:
alaṃ kṛtvā mūrtimatīṃ kṣipedagniṃ hariṃ smaran /
prādeśamātrāḥ samidho datvā parisamuhya taṃ //
24.d:
अलं कृत्वा मूर्तिमतीं क्षिपेदग्निं हरिं स्मरन् /
प्रादेशमात्राः समिधो दत्वा परिसमुह्य तं //
24.m: Having adorned her as personified, one should deposit the fire, remembering Hari. / Offering firewood sticks measuring a span, and sweeping around it,

24.s:
darbhaistridhā paristīrya pūrvādau tatra pātrakaṃ /
āsādayedidhmavahnī bhūmau ca śrukśruvadvayaṃ //
24.d:
दर्भैस्त्रिधा परिस्तीर्य पूर्वादौ तत्र पात्रकं /
आसादयेदिध्मवह्नी भूमौ च श्रुक्श्रुवद्वयं //
24.m: and strewing [the area] three times with darbha grass beginning from the east, one should place the vessel there. / One should set down the firewood, the fire, and both the sruc and sruva on the ground;

24.s:
ājyasthālī carusthālī kuśājyañca praṇītayā /
prokṣayitvā prokṣaṇīñca gṛhītvāpūrya vāriṇā //
24.d:
आज्यस्थाली चरुस्थाली कुशाज्यञ्च प्रणीतया /
प्रोक्षयित्वा प्रोक्षणीञ्च गृहीत्वापूर्य वारिणा //
24.m: the ghee-pot, the caru-pot, the kuśa grass, and the ghee. Sprinkling them with the praṇītā [water], / and taking up the prokṣaṇī vessel and filling it with water,

24.s:
pavitrāntarhite haste pariśrāvya ca tajjalaṃ /
prāṅnītvā prokṣaṇīpātraṇ jyotiragre nidhāya ca //
24.d:
पवित्रान्तर्हिते हस्ते परिश्राव्य च तज्जलं /
प्राङ्नीत्वा प्रोक्षणीपात्रण् ज्योतिरग्रे निधाय च //
24.m: straining that water into a hand holding a pavitra, / and bringing the prokṣaṇī vessel eastward and placing it in front of the flame,

24.s:
tadadbhistriś ca samprokṣya iddhmaṃ vinyasya cāgrataḥ /
praṇītāyāṃ supuṣpāyāṃ viṣṇuṃ dhyātvottareṇa ca //
24.d:
तदद्भिस्त्रिश् च सम्प्रोक्ष्य इद्ध्मं विन्यस्य चाग्रतः /
प्रणीतायां सुपुष्पायां विष्णुं ध्यात्वोत्तरेण च //
24.m: and sprinkling three times with that water, one should lay the kindling in front. / Having meditated on Viṣṇu in the flower-adorned praṇītā [vessel] to the north,

24.s:
ājyasthālīmathājyena sampūryāgre nidhāya ca /
samplavotpavanābhyāntu kuryādājyasya saṃskṛtiṃ //
24.d:
आज्यस्थालीमथाज्येन सम्पूर्याग्रे निधाय च /
सम्प्लवोत्पवनाभ्यान्तु कुर्यादाज्यस्य संस्कृतिं //
24.m: and filling the ghee-pot with ghee and placing it in front, / one should perform the consecration of the ghee by flooding and skimming.

24.s:
akhaṇḍitāgrau nirgarbhau kuśau prādeśamātrakau /
tābhyāmuttānapāṇibhyāmaṅguṣṭhānāmikena tu //
24.d:
अखण्डिताग्रौ निर्गर्भौ कुशौ प्रादेशमात्रकौ /
ताभ्यामुत्तानपाणिभ्यामङ्गुष्ठानामिकेन तु //
24.m: With two span-length kuśa blades that are unbroken at the tips and without sprouts inside, / held by both upturned hands with thumb and ring finger,

24.s:
ājyaṃ tayostu saṅgṛhya dvirnītvā triravāṅkṣipet(2) /
sruksruvau cāpi saṅgṛhya tābhyāṃ prakṣipya vāriṇa //
:n
1 rudranāsikāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ vaktranāsikāmiti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 ādyaṃ tayostu sampūjya trīn vārānūrdhvamutkṣipediti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 61
24.d:
आज्यं तयोस्तु सङ्गृह्य द्विर्नीत्वा त्रिरवाङ्क्षिपेत्(2) /
स्रुक्स्रुवौ चापि सङ्गृह्य ताभ्यां प्रक्षिप्य वारिण //
:न्
1 रुद्रनासिकामिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः वक्त्रनासिकामिति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 आद्यं तयोस्तु सम्पूज्य त्रीन् वारानूर्ध्वमुत्क्षिपेदिति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 61
24.m:
grasping the ghee with the two of them, moving it twice, one should cast it downward three times. / Grasping also the sruc and sruva, sprinkling them with water,
[Footnotes]
1 The manuscript marked "kha" reads "rudranāsikām"; the manuscript marked "ṅa" reads "vaktranāsikām".
2 The manuscript marked "ṅa" reads "ādyaṃ tayostu sampūjya trīn vārānūrdhvamutkṣipet".

24.s:
pratapya darbhaiḥ sammṛjya punaḥ prakṣyālya caiva hi /
niṣṭapya sthāpayitvā(1) tu praṇavenaiva sādhakaḥ //
24.d:
प्रतप्य दर्भैः सम्मृज्य पुनः प्रक्ष्याल्य चैव हि /
निष्टप्य स्थापयित्वा(1) तु प्रणवेनैव साधकः //
24.m: heating them, wiping them with darbha blades, and washing them again, / and heating them thoroughly, the practitioner should set them down with the praṇava.

24.s:
praṇavādinamontena paścāddhomaṃ samācaret /
garbhādhānādikarmāṇi yāvadaṃśavyavasthayā //
24.d:
प्रणवादिनमोन्तेन पश्चाद्धोमं समाचरेत् /
गर्भाधानादिकर्माणि यावदंशव्यवस्थया //
24.m: Then, one should perform the fire oblation with [the mantra] beginning with the praṇava and ending with "namaḥ", / through the rites beginning with conception, divided into portions:

24.s:
nāmāntaṃ vratabandhāntaṃ samāvartāvasānakam /
adhikārāvasānaṃ vā karyādaṅgānusārataḥ //
24.d:
नामान्तं व्रतबन्धान्तं समावर्तावसानकम् /
अधिकारावसानं वा कर्यादङ्गानुसारतः //
24.m: ending with the naming, ending with the investiture with the sacred thread, ending with graduation from studentship, / or ending with qualification [for householdership], one should perform them according to their components.

24.s:
praṇavenopacārantu kuryātsarvatra sādhakaḥ /
aṅgair homastu kartavyo yathāvittānusārataḥ //
24.d:
प्रणवेनोपचारन्तु कुर्यात्सर्वत्र साधकः /
अङ्गैर् होमस्तु कर्तव्यो यथावित्तानुसारतः //
24.m: The practitioner should perform the attendances everywhere with the praṇava. / The fire oblation with the ancillary mantras should be performed in accordance with one's wealth.

24.s:
garbhādānantu prathamaṃ tataḥ puṃsavanaṃ smṛtam /
sīmantonnayanaṃ jātakarma nāmānnaprāśanam //
24.d:
गर्भादानन्तु प्रथमं ततः पुंसवनं स्मृतम् /
सीमन्तोन्नयनं जातकर्म नामान्नप्राशनम् //
24.m: Conception is taught as the first, then the rite for securing a male child, / the parting of the hair, the birth-rite, the naming, the first feeding of solid food,

24.s:
cūḍakṛtiṃ vratabandhaṃ vedavratānyaśeṣataḥ(2) /
samāvartanaṃ patnyā ca yogaścāthādhikārakaḥ(3) //
24.d:
चूडकृतिं व्रतबन्धं वेदव्रतान्यशेषतः(2) /
समावर्तनं पत्न्या च योगश्चाथाधिकारकः(3) //
24.m: tonsure, investiture with the sacred thread, the Vedic observances in full, / graduation from studentship, union with a wife, and then entitlement [as a householder].

24.s:
hṛdādikramato dhyātvā ekaikaṃ karma pūjya ca /
aṣṭāvaṣṭau tu juhuyāt pratikarmāhutīḥ punaḥ //
24.d:
हृदादिक्रमतो ध्यात्वा एकैकं कर्म पूज्य च /
अष्टावष्टौ तु जुहुयात् प्रतिकर्माहुतीः पुनः //
24.m: Meditating [on each rite] in order from the heart and other bodily parts, and worshiping each rite, / one should offer eight oblations for each rite.

24.s:
pūrṇāhutiṃ tato dadyāt śrucā mūlena sādhakaḥ /
vauṣaḍantena mantreṇa plutaṃ susvaramuccaran //
24.d:
पूर्णाहुतिं ततो दद्यात् श्रुचा मूलेन साधकः /
वौषडन्तेन मन्त्रेण प्लुतं सुस्वरमुच्चरन् //
24.m: Then, the practitioner should offer the full oblation with the sruc and the root mantra, / uttering a prolated, melodious tone with the mantra ending in "vauṣaṭ".

24.s:
viṣṇorvahnintu saṃskṛtya śrapayedvaiṣṇavañcarum /
ārādhya sthiṇḍile viṣṇuṃ mantrān saṃsmṛtya saṃśrapet (4) //
24.d:
विष्णोर्वह्निन्तु संस्कृत्य श्रपयेद्वैष्णवञ्चरुम् /
आराध्य स्थिण्डिले विष्णुं मन्त्रान् संस्मृत्य संश्रपेत् (4) //
24.m: Having consecrated the fire of Viṣṇu, one should cook the Vaiṣṇava caru. / Having worshiped Viṣṇu on the altar and remembering the mantras, one should boil it thoroughly.

24.s:
āsanādikrameṇaiva sāṅgāvaraṇamuttamam /
gandhapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya dhyātā devaṃ surottamam //
24.d:
आसनादिक्रमेणैव साङ्गावरणमुत्तमम् /
गन्धपुष्पैः समभ्यर्च्य ध्याता देवं सुरोत्तमम् //
24.m: Following the proper sequence beginning with the seat, having worshipped the highest Lord along with his limbs and retinue / with fragrant perfumes and flowers, the meditator, [worshipping] that supreme deity,

24.s:
ādhāyedhmamathāghārāvājyāvagnīśasaṃsthitau /
:n
1 niyujya sthāpayitveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 devavratānyaśeṣata iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 yogaścāthādhikārata iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 mantrān santarpya saṃtrapet iti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 62
vāyavyanairṛtāśādipravṛttau tu yathākramam //
24.d:
आधायेध्ममथाघारावाज्यावग्नीशसंस्थितौ /
:न्
1 नियुज्य स्थापयित्वेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 देवव्रतान्यशेषत इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 योगश्चाथाधिकारत इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 मन्त्रान् सन्तर्प्य संत्रपेत् इति ख, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 62
वायव्यनैरृताशादिप्रवृत्तौ तु यथाक्रमम् //
24.m:
should place the kindling wood, and then the two ghee-stream oblations stationed at the fire and īśa [corners],
[Footnote]
1. "having employed and set up" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "the observances of the gods entirely" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3. "and yoga according to qualification" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
4. "having gratified the mantras, he should cook" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and gha.
[Page 62]
directed in due order towards the north-west and south-west directions.

24.s:
ājyabhāgau tato hutvā cakṣuṣī dakṣiṇottare /
madhyetha juhuyātsarvamantrānarcākrameṇa tu //
24.d:
आज्यभागौ ततो हुत्वा चक्षुषी दक्षिणोत्तरे /
मध्येथ जुहुयात्सर्वमन्त्रानर्चाक्रमेण तु //
24.m: Then, having offered the two portions of clarified butter, which are the right and left eyes, / in the centre he should then offer [oblations for] all the mantras according to the sequence of worship.

24.s:
ājyena tarpayenmūrterdaśāṃśenāṅgahomakam /
śataṃ sahasraṃ vājyādyaiḥ samidbhirvā tilaiḥ saha(1) //
24.d:
आज्येन तर्पयेन्मूर्तेर्दशांशेनाङ्गहोमकम् /
शतं सहस्रं वाज्याद्यैः समिद्भिर्वा तिलैः सह(1) //
24.m: With clarified butter he should gratify the icon; with a tenth part [thereof], the oblation for the ancillary limbs, / numbering a hundred or a thousand, with ghee and other [substances], or with firewood together with sesame seeds.

24.s:
samāpyārcāntu homāntāṃ śucīn śiṣyānupoṣitān /
āhūyāgre niveśyātha hy astreṇa prokṣayet paśūn //
24.d:
समाप्यार्चान्तु होमान्तां शुचीन् शिष्यानुपोषितान् /
आहूयाग्रे निवेश्याथ ह्य् अस्त्रेण प्रोक्षयेत् पशून् //
24.m: Having concluded the worship ending with the fire oblation, he should summon the pure students who have fasted, / seat them in front, and then sprinkle those bound souls with the weapon-mantra.

24.s:
śiṣyānātmani saṃyojya avidyākarmabandhanaiḥ /
liṅgānuvṛttaś caitanyaṃ saha liṅgena pāśitam(2) //
24.d:
शिष्यानात्मनि संयोज्य अविद्याकर्मबन्धनैः /
लिङ्गानुवृत्तश् चैतन्यं सह लिङ्गेन पाशितम्(2) //
24.m: Having united the students within himself, consciousness, which follows the subtle body, / bound by the bonds of ignorance and karma along with the subtle body,

24.s:
dhyānamārgena samprokṣya vāyuvījena śodhayet /
tato dahanavījena sṛṣṭiṃ brahmāṇḍasañjñikām //
24.d:
ध्यानमार्गेन सम्प्रोक्ष्य वायुवीजेन शोधयेत् /
ततो दहनवीजेन सृष्टिं ब्रह्माण्डसञ्ज्ञिकाम् //
24.m: sprinkling it by the path of meditation, he should purify it with the wind-seed-syllable. / Then, with the fire-seed-syllable, the creation known as the cosmic egg,

24.s:
nirdagdhāṃ sakalāṃ dhyāyedbhasmakūṭanibhasthitām /
plāvayedvāriṇā bhasma saṃsāraṃ vārmayaṃsmaret(3)
24.d:
निर्दग्धां सकलां ध्यायेद्भस्मकूटनिभस्थिताम् /
प्लावयेद्वारिणा भस्म संसारं वार्मयंस्मरेत्(3)
24.m: he should meditate upon as entirely burnt up, standing like a heap of ashes. / He should inundate the ashes with water, and contemplate the cyclic world as composed of water.

24.s:
tatra śaktiṃ nyaset paścāt pārthivīṃ bījasañjñikām /
tanmātrābhiḥ samastābhiḥ saṃvṛtaṃ pārthivaṃ śubham //
24.d:
तत्र शक्तिं न्यसेत् पश्चात् पार्थिवीं बीजसञ्ज्ञिकाम् /
तन्मात्राभिः समस्ताभिः संवृतं पार्थिवं शुभम् //
24.m: There he should then deposit the power of earth called the seed-syllable. / Enveloped by all the subtle elements, auspicious and earthy,

24.s:
aṇḍantadudbhavandhyāyettadādhārantadātmakam /
tanmadhye cintayenmūrtiṃ pauruṣīṃ praṇavātmikām //
24.d:
अण्डन्तदुद्भवन्ध्यायेत्तदाधारन्तदात्मकम् /
तन्मध्ये चिन्तयेन्मूर्तिं पौरुषीं प्रणवात्मिकाम् //
24.m: he should meditate upon the egg arising from that, based on that and consisting of that. / In the middle of it, he should contemplate the person-form consisting of the praṇava.

24.s:
liṅgaṃ saṅkrāmayet paścādātmasthaṃ pūrvasaṃskṛtam (4) /
vibhaktendriyasaṃsthānaṃ kramād vṛddhaṃ vicintayet //
24.d:
लिङ्गं सङ्क्रामयेत् पश्चादात्मस्थं पूर्वसंस्कृतम् (4) /
विभक्तेन्द्रियसंस्थानं क्रमाद् वृद्धं विचिन्तयेत् //
24.m: He should then transfer the subtle body situated within himself, consecrated previously; / he should visualize it growing by degrees, with its bodily organs properly differentiated.

24.s:
tatoṇḍamabdamekaṃ tu sthitvā dviśakalīkṛtam /
:n
1 samidbhirvā tilais tathā iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 saha liṅgena darśitamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 saṃsārañcākṣayaṃ smarediti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 sthaṇḍile pūrvasaṃskṛtamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 63
dyāvāpṛthivyau śakale tayormadhye prajāpatim //
24.d:
ततोण्डमब्दमेकं तु स्थित्वा द्विशकलीकृतम् /
:न्
1 समिद्भिर्वा तिलैस् तथा इति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 सह लिङ्गेन दर्शितमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 संसारञ्चाक्षयं स्मरेदिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 स्थण्डिले पूर्वसंस्कृतमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 63
द्यावापृथिव्यौ शकले तयोर्मध्ये प्रजापतिम् //
24.m:
Then, that egg, having stayed for a single year, splits into two;
[Footnote]
1. "or with firewood and likewise sesame seeds" is the reading in the manuscript marked gha.
2. "shown along with the subtle body" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
3. "and should contemplate cyclic existence as imperishable" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
4. "consecrated previously on the sacrificial ground" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
[Page 63]
the two halves become heaven and earth; between them, the lord of creatures

24.s:
jātaṃ dhyātvā punaḥ prokṣya praṇavena tu saṃśritam /
mantrātmakatanuṃ kṛtvā yathānyāsaṃ puroditam //
24.d:
जातं ध्यात्वा पुनः प्रोक्ष्य प्रणवेन तु संश्रितम् /
मन्त्रात्मकतनुं कृत्वा यथान्यासं पुरोदितम् //
24.m: is born; having meditated [thus], having sprinkled [them] again, taking refuge in the praṇava, / making their bodies consist of mantras according to the ritual deposition previously explained,

24.s:
viṣṇurhastaṃ tato mūrdhni datvā dhyātvā tu vaiṣṇavam /
evamekaṃ bahūn vāpi janitvā dhyānayogataḥ //
24.d:
विष्णुर्हस्तं ततो मूर्ध्नि दत्वा ध्यात्वा तु वैष्णवम् /
एवमेकं बहून् वापि जनित्वा ध्यानयोगतः //
24.m: the master, placing the hand of Viṣṇu on the head, should meditate upon the Vaiṣṇava state. / Having thus brought about the birth of one or many [students] through the yoga of meditation,

24.s:
karau saṅgṛhya mūlena netre baddhvā tu vāsasā /
netramantreṇa mantrī tān sadanenāhatena tu //
24.d:
करौ सङ्गृह्य मूलेन नेत्रे बद्ध्वा तु वाससा /
नेत्रमन्त्रेण मन्त्री तान् सदनेनाहतेन तु //
24.m: grasping their hands with the root-mantra, and binding their eyes with a cloth / using the eye-mantra, the mantrin [should lead] them, with an unbroken garment,

24.s:
kṛtapūjo guruḥ samyak devadevasya tattvavān /
śiṣyān puṣpāñjalibhṛtaḥ prāṅmukhānupaveśayet //
24.d:
कृतपूजो गुरुः सम्यक् देवदेवस्य तत्त्ववान् /
शिष्यान् पुष्पाञ्जलिभृतः प्राङ्मुखानुपवेशयेत् //
24.m: The guru, who knows the reality and has properly performed the worship of the God of gods, / should seat the disciples facing east, holding flowers in their folded hands.

24.s:
arcayeyuś ca tepyevamprasūtā guruṇā harim /
kṣiptvā puṣpāñjaliṃ tatra puṣpādibhiranantaram //
24.d:
अर्चयेयुश् च तेप्येवम्प्रसूता गुरुणा हरिम् /
क्षिप्त्वा पुष्पाञ्जलिं तत्र पुष्पादिभिरनन्तरम् //
24.m: They too, having thus been born through the guru, should worship Hari; / having cast folded hands of flowers there, immediately thereafter with flowers and other offerings,

24.s:
amantramarcanaṃ kṛtvā(1) guroḥ pādārcanantataḥ /
vidhāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt sarvasvaṃ cārdhameva vā //
24.d:
अमन्त्रमर्चनं कृत्वा(1) गुरोः पादार्चनन्ततः /
विधाय दक्षिणां दद्यात् सर्वस्वं चार्धमेव वा //
24.m: having performed the worship without mantras, then, having performed the worship of the guru's feet, / he should offer the sacrificial fee, either his entire property or half of it.

24.s:
guruḥ saṃśikṣayecchiṣyān taiḥ pūjyo nāmabhirhariḥ /
viśvaksenaṃ yajedīśaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam //
24.d:
गुरुः संशिक्षयेच्छिष्यान् तैः पूज्यो नामभिर्हरिः /
विश्वक्सेनं यजेदीशं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् //
24.m: The guru should instruct the disciples; Hari is to be worshipped by them with his names. / He should worship the lord Viṣvaksena, who bears the conch, discus, and mace.

24.s: tajjapantañca tarjanyā maṇḍalasthaṃ visarjayet //57//
24.d: तज्जपन्तञ्च तर्जन्या मण्डलस्थं विसर्जयेत् //57//
24.m: With the forefinger, reciting his mantra, he should dismiss him from the maṇḍala. //57

24.s:
viṣṇunirmālyamakhilaṃ viṣvaksenāya cārpayet /
praṇītābhis tathātmānamabhiṣicya ca kuṇḍagaṃ //
24.d:
विष्णुनिर्माल्यमखिलं विष्वक्सेनाय चार्पयेत् /
प्रणीताभिस् तथात्मानमभिषिच्य च कुण्डगं //
24.m: He should offer all the leftover offerings of Viṣṇu to Viṣvaksena. / And having sprinkled himself with the praṇītā waters, and having the fire in the fire-pit

24.s:
vahnimātmani saṃyojya viṣvaksenaṃ visarjayet /
bubhukṣuḥ sarvamāpnoti mumukṣur līyate harau //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye agnikāryādikathanaṃ nāma caturviṃśo
'dhyāyaḥ
:n
1 vāsudevārcanaṃ kṛtvā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 64
:ś atha pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
vāsudevādimantranirūpaṇaṃ
24.d:
वह्निमात्मनि संयोज्य विष्वक्सेनं विसर्जयेत् /
बुभुक्षुः सर्वमाप्नोति मुमुक्षुर् लीयते हरौ //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये अग्निकार्यादिकथनं नाम चतुर्विंशो
ऽध्यायः
:न्
1 वासुदेवार्चनं कृत्वा इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 64
:श् अथ पञ्चविंशो ऽध्यायः
वासुदेवादिमन्त्रनिरूपणं
24.m:
united within himself, he should dismiss Viṣvaksena. / One who desires enjoyment attains everything; one who desires liberation dissolves into Hari.
Thus ends the twenty-fourth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Fire Rite and Related Matters", in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
[Footnote]
1. "having performed worship of Vāsudeva" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
[Page 64]
Now, the twenty-fifth chapter.
Determination of the Mantras of Vāsudeva and Others

25.s:
nārada uvāca
vāsudevādimantrāṇāṃ pūjānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vade /
vāsudevaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ pradyumnaścāniruddhakaḥ //
25.d:
नारद उवाच
वासुदेवादिमन्त्राणां पूजानां लक्षणं वदे /
वासुदेवः सङ्कर्षणः प्रद्युम्नश्चानिरुद्धकः //
25.m: Nārada said: / I shall state the characteristics of the mantras and worship of Vāsudeva and others: / Vāsudeva, Saṅkarṣaṇa, Pradyumna, and Aniruddha;

25.s:
namo bhagavate cādau a ā aṃ aḥ svavījakāḥ(1) /
oṅkārādyā namontāś ca namo nārāyaṇastataḥ //
25.d:
नमो भगवते चादौ अ आ अं अः स्ववीजकाः(1) /
ओङ्काराद्या नमोन्ताश् च नमो नारायणस्ततः //
25.m: with "namo bhagavate" at the beginning, a, ā, aṃ, aḥ are their respective seed-syllables; / they begin with the syllable Oṃ and end with namaḥ; and then "namo nārāyaṇāya";

25.s:
oṃ tat sat brahmaṇe caiva oṃ namo viṣṇave namaḥ /
oṃ kṣauṃ oṃ namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya vai namaḥ //
25.d:
ओं तत् सत् ब्रह्मणे चैव ओं नमो विष्णवे नमः /
ओं क्षौं ओं नमो भगवते नरसिंहाय वै नमः //
25.m: "Oṃ tat sat brahmaṇe", and likewise "Oṃ namo viṣṇave namaḥ"; / "Oṃ kṣauṃ oṃ namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya vai namaḥ";

25.s:
oṃ bhūrnamo bhagavate varāhāya narādhipāḥ /
javāruṇaharidrābhā nīlaśyāmalalohitāḥ //
25.d:
ओं भूर्नमो भगवते वराहाय नराधिपाः /
जवारुणहरिद्राभा नीलश्यामललोहिताः //
25.m: "Oṃ bhūḥ namo bhagavate varāhāya", O kings; / having the luster of the China rose, dawn, and turmeric, dark blue, blackish, and red,

25.s:
meghāgnimadhupiṅgābhā vallabhā nava nāyakāḥ /
aṅgāni svaravījānāṃ svanāmāntair yathākramam //
25.d:
मेघाग्निमधुपिङ्गाभा वल्लभा नव नायकाः /
अङ्गानि स्वरवीजानां स्वनामान्तैर् यथाक्रमम् //
25.m: having the luster of a cloud, fire, and honey-reddish, the nine beloved leaders [are thus]. / The ancillary limbs of the vowel-seed-syllables, ending with their respective names in due order,

25.s:
hṛdayādīni kalpeta vibhaktaistantravedibhiḥ /
vyañjanādīni vījāni teṣāṃ lakṣaṇamanyathā //
25.d:
हृदयादीनि कल्पेत विभक्तैस्तन्त्रवेदिभिः /
व्यञ्जनादीनि वीजानि तेषां लक्षणमन्यथा //
25.m: the heart and the others, should be arranged by those who know the tantras as distinct. / The consonants and others are seed-syllables; their characteristic is otherwise:

25.s:
dīrghasvaraistu bhinnāni namontāntasthitāni tu /
aṅgāni hrasvayuktāni upāṅgānīti varṇyate //
25.d:
दीर्घस्वरैस्तु भिन्नानि नमोन्तान्तस्थितानि तु /
अङ्गानि ह्रस्वयुक्तानि उपाङ्गानीति वर्ण्यते //
25.m: divided by long vowels, ending with namaḥ, / the limbs joined with short vowels are described as the minor limbs.

25.s:
vibhaktanāmavarṇāntasthitāni vījamuttamaṃ(2) /
dīrghair hrasvaiś ca saṃyuktaṃ sāṅgopāṅgaṃsvaraiḥ kramāt(3) //
25.d:
विभक्तनामवर्णान्तस्थितानि वीजमुत्तमं(2) /
दीर्घैर् ह्रस्वैश् च संयुक्तं साङ्गोपाङ्गंस्वरैः क्रमात्(3) //
25.m: The excellent seed-syllable standing at the end of the divided letters of the name, / joined with long and short vowels, with limbs and minor limbs in sequence,

25.s:
vyañjanānāṃ kramo hy eṣa hṛdayādiprakḷptaye /
svavījena svanāmāntair vibhaktānyaṅganāmabhiḥ //
:n
1 dvādaśākṣaravījakā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 sthitavījārthamuttamamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 dīrghasvaraiś ca saṃyuktamaṅgopāṅgaṃ svaraiḥ kramāditi kha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 svaravījeṣu nāmāntair vibhaktānyaṅganāmabhiriti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 65
25.d:
व्यञ्जनानां क्रमो ह्य् एष हृदयादिप्रकॢप्तये /
स्ववीजेन स्वनामान्तैर् विभक्तान्यङ्गनामभिः //
:न्
1 द्वादशाक्षरवीजका इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 स्थितवीजार्थमुत्तममिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 दीर्घस्वरैश् च संयुक्तमङ्गोपाङ्गं स्वरैः क्रमादिति ख,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 स्वरवीजेषु नामान्तैर् विभक्तान्यङ्गनामभिरिति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 65
25.m:
this is indeed the order of the consonants for the formation of the heart and the other limbs, / distinguished by its own seed-syllable, ending with its own name, by the names of the limbs.
[Footnote]
1. "having the twelve-syllable seed-mantras" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "the highest meaning of the established seed-syllable" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3. "and joined with long vowels, limb and minor limb in sequence by vowels" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
4. "among the vowel-seeds, ending with names, divided by the names of the limbs" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
[Page 65]

25.s:
yuktāni hṛdayādīni dvādaśāntāni pañcataḥ(1) /
ārabhya kalpayitvā tu japet siddhyanurūpataḥ //
25.d:
युक्तानि हृदयादीनि द्वादशान्तानि पञ्चतः(1) /
आरभ्य कल्पयित्वा तु जपेत् सिद्ध्यनुरूपतः //
25.m: Endowed with the heart and others, ending with twelve, beginning from five, / having arranged them, one should recite them in accordance with [the desired] supernatural attainment.

25.s:
hṛdayañca śiraścūḍā kavacaṃ netramastrakaṃ /
ṣaḍaṅgāni tu vījānāṃ mūlasya dvādaśāṅgakaṃ //
25.d:
हृदयञ्च शिरश्चूडा कवचं नेत्रमस्त्रकं /
षडङ्गानि तु वीजानां मूलस्य द्वादशाङ्गकं //
25.m: Heart, head, tuft of hair, armour, eye, and weapon / are the six limbs of the seed-syllables; the root-mantra has twelve limbs:

25.s:
hṛcchiraś ca śikhā varma cāstranetrāntayodaraṃ /
praṣṭabāhūrujānūṃś ca jaṅghā pādau kramānnyaset //
25.d:
हृच्छिरश् च शिखा वर्म चास्त्रनेत्रान्तयोदरं /
प्रष्टबाहूरुजानूंश् च जङ्घा पादौ क्रमान्न्यसेत् //
25.m: heart, head, tuft, armour, and ending with weapon and eye; the belly, / back, arms, thighs, knees, shanks, and feet—he should deposit them in order:

25.s:
kaṃ ṭaṃ paṃ śaṃ vainateyaḥ khaṃ ṭhaṃ phaṃ ghaṃgadāmanuḥ(2) /
gaṃ ḍaṃ baṃ saṃ puṣṭhimanto ghaṃ ḍhaṃ bhaṃ haṃ śriyainamaḥ //
25.d:
कं टं पं शं वैनतेयः खं ठं फं घंगदामनुः(2) /
गं डं बं सं पुष्ठिमन्तो घं ढं भं हं श्रियैनमः //
25.m: kaṃ, ṭaṃ, paṃ, śaṃ for Garuḍa; khaṃ, ṭhaṃ, phaṃ, ghaṃ is the mace-mantra; / gaṃ, ḍaṃ, baṃ, saṃ for Puṣṭi; ghaṃ, ḍhaṃ, bhaṃ, haṃ, homage to Śrī;

25.s:
vaṃ śaṃ maṃ kṣaṃ(3) pāñcajanyaṃ chaṃ taṃ paṃ(4)kaustubhāya ca /
jaṃ khaṃ vaṃ sudarśanāya śrīvatsāya saṃ vaṃ daṃ caṃlaṃ(5) //
25.d:
वं शं मं क्षं(3) पाञ्चजन्यं छं तं पं(4)कौस्तुभाय च /
जं खं वं सुदर्शनाय श्रीवत्साय सं वं दं चंलं(5) //
25.m: vaṃ, śaṃ, maṃ, kṣaṃ for Pāñcajanya; chaṃ, taṃ, paṃ for the Kaustubha gem; / jaṃ, khaṃ, vaṃ for Sudarśana; saṃ, vaṃ, daṃ, caṃ, laṃ for Śrīvatsa;

25.s:
oṃ dhaṃ vaṃ vanamālāyai mahānantāya vai namaḥ(6) /
nirvījapadamantrāṇāṃ padair aṅgāni kalpayet //
25.d:
ओं धं वं वनमालायै महानन्ताय वै नमः(6) /
निर्वीजपदमन्त्राणां पदैर् अङ्गानि कल्पयेत् //
25.m: Oṃ dhaṃ vaṃ, homage to the garland of forest flowers and to great Ananta. / For word-mantras devoid of seed-syllables, he should construct the limbs by means of words.

25.s:
jātyantair nāmasaṃyukterhṛdayādīni pañcadhā /
praṇavaṃ hṛdayādīni tataḥ proktāni pañcadhā //
25.d:
जात्यन्तैर् नामसंयुक्तेर्हृदयादीनि पञ्चधा /
प्रणवं हृदयादीनि ततः प्रोक्तानि पञ्चधा //
25.m: The [mantras] of the heart and the rest are fivefold, ending with the appropriate grammatical ending and combined with the name. / The Praṇava, the heart, and the rest are thus stated to be fivefold:

25.s:
praṇavaṃ hṛdayaṃ pūrvaṃ parāyeti śiraḥ śikhā /
nāmnātmanā tu(7) kavacaṃ astraṃ nāmāntakaṃ bhavet //
:n
1 dvādaśārṇāni yatnata iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 mahāgadā iti ṅa,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 ṭhaṃ ṇaṃ maṃ kṣaṃ iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 daṃ bhaṃ pamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 śrīvatsāya ca pañcamamiti ṅa, cihnitapustkapāṭhaḥ śrīvatso
vaṃ caṃ daṃ ṭhaṃ laṃ iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
6 namonantāya vai nama iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
7 nāmnāmunā tu iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustkadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 66
25.d:
प्रणवं हृदयं पूर्वं परायेति शिरः शिखा /
नाम्नात्मना तु(7) कवचं अस्त्रं नामान्तकं भवेत् //
:न्
1 द्वादशार्णानि यत्नत इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 महागदा इति ङ,चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 ठं णं मं क्षं इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 दं भं पमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 श्रीवत्साय च पञ्चममिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्त्कपाठः श्रीवत्सो
वं चं दं ठं लं इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
6 नमोनन्ताय वै नम इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
7 नाम्नामुना तु इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्त्कद्वयपाठः
:प् 66
25.m:
The Praṇava is first, followed by the heart; with "to the supreme" [parāya], the head [and] the crest; / with the name and "the Self" [ātmane], the armor; the weapon ends with the name.
:n
1. "dvādaśārṇāni yatnataḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2. "mahāgadā" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
3. "ṭhaṃ ṇaṃ maṃ kṣaṃ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
4. "daṃ bhaṃ pam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
5. "śrīvatsāya ca pañcamam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa; "śrīvatso vaṃ caṃ daṃ ṭhaṃ laṃ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
6. "namonantāya vai namaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
7. "nāmnāmunā tu" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ṅa. / :p 66

25.s:
oṃ parāstrādisvanāmātmā(1) caturthyanto namontakaḥ /
ekavyūhādiṣaḍviṃśavyūhāttasyātmano manuḥ(2) //
25.d:
ओं परास्त्रादिस्वनामात्मा(1) चतुर्थ्यन्तो नमोन्तकः /
एकव्यूहादिषड्विंशव्यूहात्तस्यात्मनो मनुः(2) //
25.m: Oṃ, the supreme weapon and so forth, composed of one's own name, ending in the dative case and concluding with "namaḥ"— / this is the mantra of that Self, ranging from the single emanation up to the twenty-six emanations.

25.s:
kaniṣṭādikarāgreṣu prakṛtiṃ dehakercayet /
parāya puruṣātmā syāt prakṛtyātmā dvirūpakaḥ //
25.d:
कनिष्टादिकराग्रेषु प्रकृतिं देहकेर्चयेत् /
पराय पुरुषात्मा स्यात् प्रकृत्यात्मा द्विरूपकः //
25.m: One should worship Prakṛti at the tips of the fingers beginning with the little finger and on the body. / The supreme would be the nature of Puruṣa; the two-formed is of the nature of Prakṛti.

25.s:
oṃ parayāmnyātmane caiva vāyvarkau ca dvirūpakaḥ /
agniṃ trimūrtau(3) vinyasya vyāpakaṃ karadehayoḥ //
25.d:
ओं परयाम्न्यात्मने चैव वाय्वर्कौ च द्विरूपकः /
अग्निं त्रिमूर्तौ(3) विन्यस्य व्यापकं करदेहयोः //
25.m: "Oṃ, unto the supreme radiant Self," and also wind and the sun are the two-formed. / Having deposited Agni in the triple form, pervasively upon the hands and body,

25.s:
vāyvarkau karaśākhāsu savyetarakaradvaye /
hṛdi mūrto tanāveṣa trivyūhe turyarūpake //
25.d:
वाय्वर्कौ करशाखासु सव्येतरकरद्वये /
हृदि मूर्तो तनावेष त्रिव्यूहे तुर्यरूपके //
25.m: [one should deposit] wind and the sun on the fingers of both the left and other hand, / this [deity] embodied in the heart in the bodily form, in the triple emanation and in the fourth form.

25.s:
ṛgvedaṃ vyāpakaṃ haste aṅgulīṣu yajurnyaset /
taladvayetharvarūpaṃ śirohṛccaraṇāntakaḥ //
25.d:
ऋग्वेदं व्यापकं हस्ते अङ्गुलीषु यजुर्न्यसेत् /
तलद्वयेथर्वरूपं शिरोहृच्चरणान्तकः //
25.m: One should deposit the Ṛgveda pervasively in the hand, the Yajurveda upon the fingers, / the form of the Atharvaveda upon the two palms, ending with the head, heart, and feet.

25.s:
ākāśaṃ vyāpakaṃ nyasya kare dehe tu pūrvavat /
aṅgulīṣu ca vāyvādi śirohṛdguhyapādake //
25.d:
आकाशं व्यापकं न्यस्य करे देहे तु पूर्ववत् /
अङ्गुलीषु च वाय्वादि शिरोहृद्गुह्यपादके //
25.m: Having deposited space pervasively in the hand and on the body as before, / and the wind and the rest upon the fingers, [one deposits them] on the head, heart, genitals, and feet.

25.s:
vāyurjyotirjalaṃ pṛthvī pañcavyūhaḥ samīritaḥ /
manaḥ śrotrantvagdṛgjihvā ghrāṇaṃ ṣaḍvyūha īritaḥ //
25.d:
वायुर्ज्योतिर्जलं पृथ्वी पञ्चव्यूहः समीरितः /
मनः श्रोत्रन्त्वग्दृग्जिह्वा घ्राणं षड्व्यूह ईरितः //
25.m: Wind, fire, water, and earth: this is declared as the fivefold emanation. / The mind, ear, skin, eye, tongue, and nose are declared as the sixfold emanation.

25.s:
vyāpakaṃ mānasaṃ nyasya tatoṅguṣṭāditaḥ kramāt /
mūrdhāsyahṛdguhyapatsu kathitaḥ karuṇātmakaḥ //
25.d:
व्यापकं मानसं न्यस्य ततोङ्गुष्टादितः क्रमात् /
मूर्धास्यहृद्गुह्यपत्सु कथितः करुणात्मकः //
25.m: Having deposited the mind pervasively, then in sequence from the thumbs onward, / [and] on the head, mouth, heart, genitals, and feet, the compassionate [Self] is declared.

25.s:
ādimūrtistu sarvatra vyāpako jīvasañjñitaḥ /
bhūrbhuvaḥ svarmaharjanastapaḥ styañca saptadhā //
25.d:
आदिमूर्तिस्तु सर्वत्र व्यापको जीवसञ्ज्ञितः /
भूर्भुवः स्वर्महर्जनस्तपः स्त्यञ्च सप्तधा //
25.m: The primal form is pervasive everywhere, known as the individual self [jīva]. / Earth, atmosphere, heaven, Maharloka, Janaloka, Tapoloka, and Satyaloka are the sevenfold.

25.s:
kare dehe nyasedādyamaṅguṣṭādikrameṇa tu /
talasaṃsthaḥ saptamaś ca(4) lokeśo dehake kramāt //
:n
1 oṃ parāstrādityanāmātmā iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 evaṃ vyūhādiṣaḍviṃśaṃ vyūhāttasyātmano manuriti kha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 agniṃ dvimūrtau iti kha, cihnitapustkapāṭhaḥ
4 talasthaḥ saptamaś caiva iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 67
25.d:
करे देहे न्यसेदाद्यमङ्गुष्टादिक्रमेण तु /
तलसंस्थः सप्तमश् च(4) लोकेशो देहके क्रमात् //
:न्
1 ओं परास्त्रादित्यनामात्मा इति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 एवं व्यूहादिषड्विंशं व्यूहात्तस्यात्मनो मनुरिति ख,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 अग्निं द्विमूर्तौ इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्त्कपाठः
4 तलस्थः सप्तमश् चैव इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 67
25.m:
One should deposit the primary one in the hand and on the body in the sequence from the thumbs onward; / and situated on the palm is the seventh, the lord of the worlds, in sequence on the body.
:n
1. "oṃ parāstrādityanāmātmā" is the reading in the manuscript marked gha.
2. "evaṃ vyūhādiṣaḍviṃśaṃ vyūhāttasyātmano manuḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3. "agniṃ dvimūrtau" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
4. "talasthaḥ saptamaś caiva" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / :p 67

25.s:
dehe śirolalāṭāsyahṛdguhyāṅgriṣu saṃsthitaḥ /
agniṣṭhomastathokthastu ṣoḍaśī vājapeyakaḥ //
25.d:
देहे शिरोललाटास्यहृद्गुह्याङ्ग्रिषु संस्थितः /
अग्निष्ठोमस्तथोक्थस्तु षोडशी वाजपेयकः //
25.m: Stationed on the body at the head, forehead, mouth, heart, genitals, and feet / are the Agniṣṭoma, then the Ukthya, the Ṣoḍaśin, the Vājapeya,

25.s:
atirātrāptoryāmañca(1) yajñātmā saptarūpakaḥ /
dhīrahaṃ manaḥ śabdaś ca sparśarūparasāstataḥ(2) //
25.d:
अतिरात्राप्तोर्यामञ्च(1) यज्ञात्मा सप्तरूपकः /
धीरहं मनः शब्दश् च स्पर्शरूपरसास्ततः(2) //
25.m: the Atirātra, and the Aptoryāma—the sevenfold embodiment of sacrifice. / Intellect, ego, mind, and sound; then touch, form, and taste;

25.s:
gandho buddhirvyāpakaṃ tu kare dehe nyaset kramāt /
nyasedantyai ca(3) talayoḥ ke lalāṭe mukhe hṛdi //
25.d:
गन्धो बुद्धिर्व्यापकं तु करे देहे न्यसेत् क्रमात् /
न्यसेदन्त्यै च(3) तलयोः के ललाटे मुखे हृदि //
25.m: and smell: having deposited intellect pervasively on the hands and body in sequence, / one should deposit the rest on the two palms, on the head, forehead, mouth, and heart,

25.s:
nābhau guhye ca pāde ca aṣṭavyūhaḥ pumān smṛtaḥ(4) /
vījo buddhirahaṅkāro manaḥ śabdo guṇonilaḥ //
25.d:
नाभौ गुह्ये च पादे च अष्टव्यूहः पुमान् स्मृतः(4) /
वीजो बुद्धिरहङ्कारो मनः शब्दो गुणोनिलः //
25.m: at the navel, the genitals, and the feet; the eightfold emanation is known as Puruṣa. / The seed, intellect, ego, mind, sound, the attribute of wind,

25.s:
rūpaṃ raso navātmāyaṃ jīva aṅguṣṭhakadvaye /
tarjanyādikramāccheṣaṃ yāvadvāmapradeśinīṃ //
25.d:
रूपं रसो नवात्मायं जीव अङ्गुष्ठकद्वये /
तर्जन्यादिक्रमाच्छेषं यावद्वामप्रदेशिनीं //
25.m: form, and taste: this is the ninefold Self, the individual self on the two thumbs, / the remainder in sequence from the forefingers up to the left index finger.

25.s:
dehe śirolalāṭāsyahṛnnābhiguhyajānuṣu /
pādayoś ca daśātmāyaṃ indro vyāpī samāsthitaḥ //
25.d:
देहे शिरोललाटास्यहृन्नाभिगुह्यजानुषु /
पादयोश् च दशात्मायं इन्द्रो व्यापी समास्थितः //
25.m: On the body: at the head, forehead, mouth, heart, navel, genitals, knees, / and the two feet, this tenfold Self, the all-pervading Indra, is situated.

25.s:
aṅguṣṭhakadvaye vahnistarjanyādau pareṣu ca /
śirolalāṭavaktreṣu hṛnnābhiguhyajānuṣu //
25.d:
अङ्गुष्ठकद्वये वह्निस्तर्जन्यादौ परेषु च /
शिरोललाटवक्त्रेषु हृन्नाभिगुह्यजानुषु //
25.m: Fire is on the two thumbs, and the other [entities] on the forefingers and the rest; / on the head, forehead, mouth, heart, navel, genitals, knees,

25.s:
pādayorekadaśātmā manaḥ śrotraṃ tvageva ca /
cakṣurjihvā tathā ghrāṇaṃ vākpāṇyaṅghriś ca pāyukaḥ //
25.d:
पादयोरेकदशात्मा मनः श्रोत्रं त्वगेव च /
चक्षुर्जिह्वा तथा घ्राणं वाक्पाण्यङ्घ्रिश् च पायुकः //
25.m: and the two feet is the elevenfold Self: mind, ear, and skin, / eye, tongue, and nose, speech, hands, feet, and anus,

25.s:
upasthaṃ mānaso vyāpī śrotramaṅguṣṭhakadvaye /
tarjanyādikramādaṣṭau atiriktaṃ taladvaye //
25.d:
उपस्थं मानसो व्यापी श्रोत्रमङ्गुष्ठकद्वये /
तर्जन्यादिक्रमादष्टौ अतिरिक्तं तलद्वये //
25.m: and genitals; the mental all-pervading [Self] [is pervasive], the ear on the two thumbs, / eight in sequence from the forefinger onward, and the remainder on the two palms.

25.s:
uttamāṅgulalalāṭāsyahṛnnābhāvatha guhyake /
uruyugme tathā jaṅghe gulphapādeṣu ca kramāt //
:n
1 atirātrāptayāmaś ca iti kha, cihnitapustkapāṭhaḥ
2 rasās tathā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 nyasedante ca iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / nyasedaṣṭau ca iti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 kramāt smṛta iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭḥaḥ
:p 68
25.d:
उत्तमाङ्गुलललाटास्यहृन्नाभावथ गुह्यके /
उरुयुग्मे तथा जङ्घे गुल्फपादेषु च क्रमात् //
:न्
1 अतिरात्राप्तयामश् च इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्त्कपाठः
2 रसास् तथा इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 न्यसेदन्ते च इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / न्यसेदष्टौ च इति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 क्रमात् स्मृत इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाट्ःअः
:प् 68
25.m:
On the crown of the head, forehead, mouth, heart, navel, then the genitals, / on the two thighs, as well as the shanks, ankles, and feet in sequence:
:n
1. "atirātrāptayāmaś ca" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "rasās tathā" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3. "nyasedante ca" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "nyasedaṣṭau ca" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
4. "kramāt smṛtaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / :p 68

25.s:
viṣṇurmadhuharaś caiva trivikramakavāmanau /
śrīdharotha hṛṣīkeśaḥ padmanābhastathaiva ca //
25.d:
विष्णुर्मधुहरश् चैव त्रिविक्रमकवामनौ /
श्रीधरोथ हृषीकेशः पद्मनाभस्तथैव च //
25.m: Viṣṇu, Madhuhara, Trivikrama, and Vāmana, / Śrīdhara, then Hṛṣīkeśa, and likewise Padmanābha,

25.s:
dāmodaraḥ keśavaś ca nārāyaṇastataḥ paraḥ /
mādhavaścātha govindo viṣṇuṃ vai vyāpakaṃ nyaset //
25.d:
दामोदरः केशवश् च नारायणस्ततः परः /
माधवश्चाथ गोविन्दो विष्णुं वै व्यापकं न्यसेत् //
25.m: Dāmodara, Keśava, Nārāyaṇa next, / Mādhava, and then Govinda—one should deposit Viṣṇu as pervasive.

25.s:
aṅguṣṭhādau tale dvau ca pāde jānuni vai kaṭau /
śiraḥśikharakaṭyāñca jānupādādiṣu nyaset //
25.d:
अङ्गुष्ठादौ तले द्वौ च पादे जानुनि वै कटौ /
शिरःशिखरकट्याञ्च जानुपादादिषु न्यसेत् //
25.m: On the thumbs and the rest, two on the palm, on the feet, knees, hips, / on the crown of the head, waist, and knees, feet, and so on, one should deposit.

25.s:
dvādaśātmā pañcaviṃśaḥ ṣaḍviṃśavyūhakas tathā /
puruṣo dhīrahaṅkāro manaścittañca śabdakaḥ //
25.d:
द्वादशात्मा पञ्चविंशः षड्विंशव्यूहकस् तथा /
पुरुषो धीरहङ्कारो मनश्चित्तञ्च शब्दकः //
25.m: Thus the twelvefold Self, the twenty-fivefold, and the twenty-sixfold emanation: / Puruṣa, intellect, ego, mind, thought, and sound,

25.s:
tathā sparśo raso rūpaṃ gandhaḥ śrotraṃ tvacas tathā /
cakṣurjihvā nāsikā ca vākpāṇyaṅghriś ca pāyavaḥ //
25.d:
तथा स्पर्शो रसो रूपं गन्धः श्रोत्रं त्वचस् तथा /
चक्षुर्जिह्वा नासिका च वाक्पाण्यङ्घ्रिश् च पायवः //
25.m: likewise touch, taste, form, smell, ear, and skin, / eye, tongue, nose, speech, hands, feet, and anus,

25.s:
upastho bhūrjalantejo vāyurākāśameva ca /
puruṣaṃ vyāpakaṃ nyasya aṅguṣṭhādau daśa nyaset //
25.d:
उपस्थो भूर्जलन्तेजो वायुराकाशमेव च /
पुरुषं व्यापकं न्यस्य अङ्गुष्ठादौ दश न्यसेत् //
25.m: genitals, earth, water, fire, wind, and space: / having deposited Puruṣa as pervasive, one should deposit ten on the thumbs and the rest,

25.s:
śeṣān hastatale nyasya śirasyatha lalāṭake /
mukhahṛnnābhiguhyorujānvaṅghrau karaṇodgatau //
25.d:
शेषान् हस्ततले न्यस्य शिरस्यथ ललाटके /
मुखहृन्नाभिगुह्योरुजान्वङ्घ्रौ करणोद्गतौ //
25.m: depositing the remainder on the palms of the hands; on the head, then on the forehead, / mouth, heart, navel, genitals, thighs, knees, and feet, arising from the faculties;

25.s:
pāde jānvorupasthe ca hṛdaye mūrdhni ca kramāt /
paraś ca puruṣātmādau ṣaḍviṃśe pūrvavatparaṃ //
25.d:
पादे जान्वोरुपस्थे च हृदये मूर्ध्नि च क्रमात् /
परश् च पुरुषात्मादौ षड्विंशे पूर्ववत्परं //
25.m: on the feet, knees, genitals, heart, and head in sequence. / The supreme Self of Puruṣa is at the beginning; in the twenty-sixth, the Supreme is as before.

25.s:
sañcintya maṇḍalaike tu prakṛtiṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ /
pūrvayāmyāpyasaumyeṣu hṛdayādīni pūjayet //
25.d:
सञ्चिन्त्य मण्डलैके तु प्रकृतिं पूजयेद्बुधः /
पूर्वयाम्याप्यसौम्येषु हृदयादीनि पूजयेत् //
25.m: Having meditated in a single maṇḍala, the wise one should worship Prakṛti; / in the east, south, west, and north, one should worship the heart and other [limbs];

25.s:
astramagnyādikoṇeṣu(1) vainateyādi pūrvavat /
dikpālāṃś ca vidhistvanyaḥ(2) trivyūhegniś ca madhyataḥ //
25.d:
अस्त्रमग्न्यादिकोणेषु(1) वैनतेयादि पूर्ववत् /
दिक्पालांश् च विधिस्त्वन्यः(2) त्रिव्यूहेग्निश् च मध्यतः //
25.m: the weapon in the corners beginning with the south-east, Vainateya and the rest as before, / and the guardians of the directions; but another procedure applies in the triple emanation, with Agni in the middle,

25.s:
pūrvādidigbalāvasorājyādibhiralaṅkṛtaḥ /
karṇikāyāṃ nābhasaś ca mānasaḥ karṇikāsthitaḥ //
:n
1 astramagnyādipatreṣu iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 dikpālāṃś ca vidhistasya iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
dikpālādau vidhistulya iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 69
25.d:
पूर्वादिदिग्बलावसोराज्यादिभिरलङ्कृतः /
कर्णिकायां नाभसश् च मानसः कर्णिकास्थितः //
:न्
1 अस्त्रमग्न्यादिपत्रेषु इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 दिक्पालांश् च विधिस्तस्य इति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
दिक्पालादौ विधिस्तुल्य इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 69
25.m:
adorned with ghee and other offerings to the strength-wealth of the directions beginning with the east; / and the celestial one in the pericarp, while the mental one is stationed in the pericarp.
:n
1. "astramagnyādipatreṣu" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ṅa.
2. "dikpālāṃś ca vidhistasya" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and gha; "dikpālādau vidhistulyaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / :p 69

25.s:
viśvarūpaṃ sarvasthityai(1) yajedrājyajayāya ca /
sarvavyūhaiḥ samāyuktamaṅgair api ca pañcabhiḥ //
25.d:
विश्वरूपं सर्वस्थित्यै(1) यजेद्राज्यजयाय च /
सर्वव्यूहैः समायुक्तमङ्गैर् अपि च पञ्चभिः //
25.m: One should worship the Cosmic Form for the maintenance of all and for victory over the kingdom, / endowed with all emanations and with the five limbs,

25.s:
garuḍādyaistathendrādyaiḥ sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt /
viśvaksenaṃ yajennāmnā vai vījaṃ vyomasaṃsthitaṃ(2) //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye mantrapradarśanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo
'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
mudrālakṣaṇakathanaṃ
25.d:
गरुडाद्यैस्तथेन्द्राद्यैः सर्वान् कामानवाप्नुयात् /
विश्वक्सेनं यजेन्नाम्ना वै वीजं व्योमसंस्थितं(2) //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये मन्त्रप्रदर्शनं नाम पञ्चविंशो
ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ षड्विंशो ऽध्यायः
मुद्रालक्षणकथनं
25.m:
together with Garuḍa and the others, and Indra and the others; one shall obtain all desires. / One should worship Viṣvaksena by name, with the seed-syllable stationed in the ether.
:e Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter, entitled "Exposition of Mantras," in the ancient and great Agni Purāṇa.
:ś Now the twenty-sixth chapter:
Description of the Characteristics of Ritual Gestures

26.s:
nārada uvāca
mudrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye sānnidhyādiprakārakaṃ /
añjaliḥ prathamā mudrā vandanī hṛdayānugā //
26.d:
नारद उवाच
मुद्राणां लक्षणं वक्ष्ये सान्निध्यादिप्रकारकं /
अञ्जलिः प्रथमा मुद्रा वन्दनी हृदयानुगा //
26.m: Nārada said: / I shall explain the characteristics of the ritual gestures, which cause [the deity's] presence and so forth. / The first ritual gesture is the folded hands (añjali), used in salutation, held near the heart.

26.s:
ūrdhvāṅguṣṭhovāmamuṣṭirdakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhabandhanaṃ /
savyasya tasya cāṅguṣṭho yasya cordhve prakīrtitaḥ(3) //
26.d:
ऊर्ध्वाङ्गुष्ठोवाममुष्टिर्दक्षिणाङ्गुष्ठबन्धनं /
सव्यस्य तस्य चाङ्गुष्ठो यस्य चोर्ध्वे प्रकीर्तितः(3) //
26.m: The left fist has the thumb raised; the right thumb is clasped, / and the thumb of the right hand is stated to be upright.

26.s:
tisraḥ sādharaṇā vyūhe athāsādharaṇā imāḥ /
kaniṣṭhādivimokena aṣṭo mudrā yathākramaṃ //
26.d:
तिस्रः साधरणा व्यूहे अथासाधरणा इमाः /
कनिष्ठादिविमोकेन अष्टो मुद्रा यथाक्रमं //
26.m: Three are common to the divine emanations (vyūha); now these are the specific ones: / by releasing [the fingers] starting from the little finger, the eight ritual gestures are formed in order.

26.s:
aṣṭānāṃ pūrvavījānāṃ kramaśastvavadhārayet /
aṅguṣṭhena kaniṣṭāntaṃ namayitvāṅgulitrayaṃ //
26.d:
अष्टानां पूर्ववीजानां क्रमशस्त्ववधारयेत् /
अङ्गुष्ठेन कनिष्टान्तं नमयित्वाङ्गुलित्रयं //
26.m: One should understand them in the order of the eight preliminary seed-syllables: / having bent the three fingers ending with the little finger with the thumb,

26.s:
ūrdhvaṃ kṛtvā sammukhañca vījāya navamāya vai /
vāmahastamathottānaṃ kṛtvārdhaṃ nāmayecchanaiḥ //
:n
1 sarvasiddhyai iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 vairājaṃ nāgasaṃyutamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭḥaḥ / yau
vījaṃ cāṅgasaṃyutamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 yaḥ savyerdhe prakīrtita iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 70
26.d:
ऊर्ध्वं कृत्वा सम्मुखञ्च वीजाय नवमाय वै /
वामहस्तमथोत्तानं कृत्वार्धं नामयेच्छनैः //
:न्
1 सर्वसिद्ध्यै इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 वैराजं नागसंयुतमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाट्ःअः / यौ
वीजं चाङ्गसंयुतमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 यः सव्येर्धे प्रकीर्तित इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 70
26.m:
