"Oṃ hrauṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ, I dissolve the subtle element of touch, homage! / Oṃ hrauṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ, I dissolve the subtle element of sound, homage!"
Located between the throat and the nose, circular indeed, is the circle of wind;

33.s:
dvirudghātair dhūmravarṇaṃ dhyāyecchuddhendulāñchitam /
sparśamātraṃ śabdamātraiḥ saṃhareddhyānayogataḥ //
oṃ hrauṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ śabdatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi
namaḥ
33.d:
द्विरुद्घातैर् धूम्रवर्णं ध्यायेच्छुद्धेन्दुलाञ्छितम् /
स्पर्शमात्रं शब्दमात्रैः संहरेद्ध्यानयोगतः //
ओं ह्रौं हः फट् ह्रूं शब्दतन्मात्रं संहरामि
नमः
33.m:
with two breath-expulsions, smoke-colored, marked with a pure crescent moon, he should meditate upon it; / he should dissolve the subtle element of touch into the subtle elements of sound through the practice of meditation:
"Oṃ hrauṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ, I dissolve the subtle element of sound, homage!"

33.s:
ekodghātena cākāśaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasannibham /
nāsāpuṭaśikhāntasthamākāśamupasaṃharet //
33.d:
एकोद्घातेन चाकाशं शुद्धस्फटिकसन्निभम् /
नासापुटशिखान्तस्थमाकाशमुपसंहरेत् //
33.m: And with one breath-expulsion, space, resembling pure crystal, / situated between the nostrils and the tuft of hair, he should dissolve that space.

33.s:
śoṣaṇādyair dehaśuddhiṃ kuryādevam kramāttataḥ /
śuṣkaṃ kalevaraṃ dhyāyet pādādyañca śikhāntakam //
33.d:
शोषणाद्यैर् देहशुद्धिं कुर्यादेवम् क्रमात्ततः /
शुष्कं कलेवरं ध्यायेत् पादाद्यञ्च शिखान्तकम् //
33.m: He should thus perform the purification of the body through desiccations and so forth in order, thereafter; / he should meditate upon the dried body from the feet up to the tuft of hair.

33.s:
yaṃ vījena vaṃ vījena jvālāmālāsamāyutam(3) /
dehaṃ ramityanenaiva brahmarandhrādvinirgatam //
33.d:
यं वीजेन वं वीजेन ज्वालामालासमायुतम्(3) /
देहं रमित्यनेनैव ब्रह्मरन्ध्राद्विनिर्गतम् //
33.m: With the seed-syllable Yaṃ, and with the seed-syllable Vaṃ, [and] endowed with a garland of flames, / the body with Raṃ itself; gone out from the aperture of Brahmā,

33.s:
vindundhyātvā cāmṛtasya tena bhasmakalevaram /
samplāvayellamityasmāt dehaṃ sampādya divyakam //
33.d:
विन्दुन्ध्यात्वा चामृतस्य तेन भस्मकलेवरम् /
सम्प्लावयेल्लमित्यस्मात् देहं सम्पाद्य दिव्यकम् //
33.m: and having meditated upon a drop of nectar, he should inundate the body of ashes with it; / having produced a divine body from this [seed-syllable] Laṃ,

33.s:
nyāsaṃ kṛtvā kare dehe mānasaṃ yāgamācaret /
viṣṇuṃ sāṅgaṃ hṛdi padme mānasaiḥ kusumādibhiḥ //
33.d:
न्यासं कृत्वा करे देहे मानसं यागमाचरेत् /
विष्णुं साङ्गं हृदि पद्मे मानसैः कुसुमादिभिः //
33.m: and having performed ritual deposition on the hands and body, he should carry out mental sacrifice / to Viṣṇu with His limbs in the lotus of the heart with mental flowers and other offerings.

33.s:
mūlamantreṇa deveśamprārcayedbhuktimuktidam /
svāgataṃ devadeveśa sannidhau bhava keśava //
33.d:
मूलमन्त्रेण देवेशम्प्रार्चयेद्भुक्तिमुक्तिदम् /
स्वागतं देवदेवेश सन्निधौ भव केशव //
33.m: With the root mantra he should worship the Lord of gods, the giver of worldly enjoyment and liberation: / "Welcome, O Lord of the gods of gods, be present near, O Keśava!

33.s:
gṛhāṇa mānasīṃ pūjāṃ yathārthaṃ(4) paribhāvitām /
ādhāraśaktiḥ kūrmātha pūjyonanto mahī tataḥ //
33.d:
गृहाण मानसीं पूजां यथार्थं(4) परिभाविताम् /
आधारशक्तिः कूर्माथ पूज्योनन्तो मही ततः //
33.m: Accept this mental worship properly conceived!" / Then the primordial power of support, the tortoise, Ananta, and the earth are to be worshipped;

33.s:
madhyegnyādau ca dharmādyā adharmādīndramukhyagam(4) /
:n
1 oṃ kṣauṃ haḥ phaṭ krūmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 oṃ kṣauṃ haḥ phaṭ krūmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 jvālāmālāsamaprabhamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 yathāsvamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 dharmādīnindrādau viparītakāniti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 97
sattvādi madhye padmañca māyāvidyākhyatattvake //
33.d:
मध्येग्न्यादौ च धर्माद्या अधर्मादीन्द्रमुख्यगम्(4) /
:न्
1 ओं क्षौं हः फट् क्रूमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 ओं क्षौं हः फट् क्रूमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 ज्वालामालासमप्रभमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 यथास्वमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 धर्मादीनिन्द्रादौ विपरीतकानिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 97
सत्त्वादि मध्ये पद्मञ्च मायाविद्याख्यतत्त्वके //
33.m:
in the center, and in the directions beginning with fire (southeast), the principles of righteousness and the rest; the non-righteousness and others in the directions beginning with Indra (east);
[Footnotes]
1 "oṃ kṣauṃ haḥ phaṭ krūm", reads manuscript marked ṅa.
2 "oṃ kṣauṃ haḥ phaṭ krūm", reads manuscript marked ṅa.
3 "jvālāmālāsamaprabham", reads manuscript marked ṅa.
4 "yathāsvam", reads manuscript marked kha.
5 "dharmādīnindrādau viparītakān", reads manuscript marked ṅa. / [Page 97]
sattva and the other [guṇas], and in the center the lotus, and the principles named Māyā and Vidyā,

33.s:
kālatattvañca sūryādimaṇḍalaṃ pakṣirājakaḥ /
madhye tataś ca vāyavyādīśāntā gurupaṅktikāḥ //
33.d:
कालतत्त्वञ्च सूर्यादिमण्डलं पक्षिराजकः /
मध्ये ततश् च वायव्यादीशान्ता गुरुपङ्क्तिकाः //
33.m: the principle of time, the circles of the sun and others, and the king of birds (Garuḍa); / in the center and then from the northwest to the northeast, the line of teachers:

33.s:
gaṇaḥ sarasvatī pūjyā(1) nārado nalakūvaraḥ /
gururgurupādukā ca paro guruś ca pādukā //
33.d:
गणः सरस्वती पूज्या(1) नारदो नलकूवरः /
गुरुर्गुरुपादुका च परो गुरुश् च पादुका //
33.m: Gaṇa and Sarasvatī are to be worshipped, Nārada, Nalakūbara, / the guru, the sandals of the guru, the higher guru, and the sandals,

33.s:
pūrvasiddhāḥ parasiddhāḥ keśareṣu ca śaktayaḥ /
lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī prītiḥ kīrtiḥ śāntiś ca kāntikā //
33.d:
पूर्वसिद्धाः परसिद्धाः केशरेषु च शक्तयः /
लक्ष्मीः सरस्वती प्रीतिः कीर्तिः शान्तिश् च कान्तिका //
33.m: the past perfected ones, the higher perfected ones, and the powers on the filaments: / Lakṣmī, Sarasvatī, Prīti, Kīrti, Śānti, Kāntikā,

33.s:
puṣṭistuṣṭirmahendrādyā madhye vācāhito hariḥ /
dhṛtiḥ śrīratikāntyādyā mūlena sthāpito 'cyutaḥ //
33.d:
पुष्टिस्तुष्टिर्महेन्द्राद्या मध्ये वाचाहितो हरिः /
धृतिः श्रीरतिकान्त्याद्या मूलेन स्थापितो ऽच्युतः //
33.m: Puṣṭi, Tuṣṭi, in the directions beginning with east; in the center, Hari who is placed by speech; / Dhṛti, Śrī, Rati, Kānti, and others; Acyuta is installed with the root [mantra].

33.s:
oṃ abhimukho bhaveti prārthya sannihito bhava /
vinyasyārghyādikaṃ datvā gandhādyair mūlato yajet //
33.d:
ओं अभिमुखो भवेति प्रार्थ्य सन्निहितो भव /
विन्यस्यार्घ्यादिकं दत्वा गन्धाद्यैर् मूलतो यजेत् //
33.m: Having prayed with: "Oṃ be facing towards [me], become present!", / having performed deposition and having offered the water offering and the like, he should worship with perfumes and so forth with the root [mantra]:

33.s:
oṃ bhīṣaya bhīṣaya hṛt śirastrāsaya vai punaḥ /
mardaya mardaya śikhā agnyādau śastratostrakaṃ //
33.d:
ओं भीषय भीषय हृत् शिरस्त्रासय वै पुनः /
मर्दय मर्दय शिखा अग्न्यादौ शस्त्रतोस्त्रकं //
33.m: "Oṃ terrify, terrify!" to the heart; "Frighten!" then to the head; / "Crush, crush!" to the tuft of hair; in the directions beginning with fire, the weapon with the weapon [mantra]:

33.s:
rakṣa rakṣa pradhvaṃsaya pradhvaṃsaya kavacāya(2) namastataḥ /
oṃ hrūṃ(3) phaṭ astrāya namo mūlavījena cāṅgakaṃ //
33.d:
रक्ष रक्ष प्रध्वंसय प्रध्वंसय कवचाय(2) नमस्ततः /
ओं ह्रूं(3) फट् अस्त्राय नमो मूलवीजेन चाङ्गकं //
33.m: "Protect, protect, destroy, destroy! Homage to the armor!" then; / "Oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ, homage to the weapon!", and the limb[-nyāsa] with the root seed-syllable.

33.s:
pūrvadakṣāpyasaumyeṣu mūrtyāvaraṇamarcayet /
vāsudevaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ pradyumnaścāniruddhakaḥ //
33.d:
पूर्वदक्षाप्यसौम्येषु मूर्त्यावरणमर्चयेत् /
वासुदेवः सङ्कर्षणः प्रद्युम्नश्चानिरुद्धकः //
33.m: In the east, south, west, and north, one should worship the enclosure of icons: / Vāsudeva, Saṅkarṣaṇa, Pradyumna, and Aniruddha.

33.s:
agnyādau śrīdhṛtiratikāntayo mūrtayo hareḥ /
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmamagnyādau pūrvakādikaṃ //
33.d:
अग्न्यादौ श्रीधृतिरतिकान्तयो मूर्तयो हरेः /
शङ्खचक्रगदापद्ममग्न्यादौ पूर्वकादिकं //
33.m: Beginning with the south-east [are] Hari's icons Śrī, Dhṛti, Rati, and Kānti. / Beginning with the east [and south-east are] the conch, discus, mace, and lotus;

33.s:
śārṅgañca muṣalaṃ khaḍgaṃ vanamālāñca tadvahiḥ /
indrādyāś ca tayānanto nairṛtyāṃ varuṇastataḥ //
33.d:
शार्ङ्गञ्च मुषलं खड्गं वनमालाञ्च तद्वहिः /
इन्द्राद्याश् च तयानन्तो नैरृत्यां वरुणस्ततः //
33.m: outside of that, the Śārṅga bow, the pestle, the sword, and the forest garland. / Indra and the other [guardians], and along with them Ananta; then Varuṇa in the south-west;

33.s:
brahmendreśānayormadhye astrāvaraṇakaṃ vahiḥ /
airāvatastataśchāgo mahiṣo vānaro jhaṣaḥ //
:n
1 gaṇaś ca tāsu pūjyo 'tha iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 rakṣa rakṣa pradhvaṃsaya kavacāyeti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 oṃ hrīmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 98
33.d:
ब्रह्मेन्द्रेशानयोर्मध्ये अस्त्रावरणकं वहिः /
ऐरावतस्ततश्छागो महिषो वानरो झषः //
:न्
1 गणश् च तासु पूज्यो ऽथ इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 रक्ष रक्ष प्रध्वंसय कवचायेति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 ओं ह्रीमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 98
33.m:
Brahmā between Indra and Īśāna; outside [is] the enclosure of weapons. / Then Airāvata, a goat, a buffalo, a monkey, a fish,
:n
1. "gaṇaś ca tāsu pūjyo 'tha" is the variant reading in manuscript ṅa.
2. "rakṣa rakṣa pradhvaṃsaya kavacāya" is the variant reading in manuscript ṅa.
3. "oṃ hrīm" is the variant reading in manuscript kha. / :p 98

33.s:
mṛgaḥ śaśo 'tha vṛṣabhaḥ kūrmo haṃsastato vahiḥ /
pṛśnigarbhaḥ kumudādyā dvārapālā dvayaṃ dvayaṃ //
33.d:
मृगः शशो ऽथ वृषभः कूर्मो हंसस्ततो वहिः /
पृश्निगर्भः कुमुदाद्या द्वारपाला द्वयं द्वयं //
33.m: a deer, a hare, then a bull, a tortoise, a swan; then outside / are Pṛśnigarbha, Kumuda, and others—the door-keepers in pairs.

33.s:
pūrvādyuttaradvārāntaṃ hariṃ natvā baliṃ vahiḥ /
viṣṇupārṣadebhyo namo balipīṭhe baliṃ dadet //
33.d:
पूर्वाद्युत्तरद्वारान्तं हरिं नत्वा बलिं वहिः /
विष्णुपार्षदेभ्यो नमो बलिपीठे बलिं ददेत् //
33.m: From the eastern entrance to the northern entrance, having bowed to Hari, outside / one should offer an oblation on the oblation pedestal, [saying,] 'Homage to the attendants of Viṣṇu.'

33.s:
viśvāya viśvaksenātmane īśānake yajet /
devasya dakṣiṇe haste rakṣāsūtrañca bandhayet //
33.d:
विश्वाय विश्वक्सेनात्मने ईशानके यजेत् /
देवस्य दक्षिणे हस्ते रक्षासूत्रञ्च बन्धयेत् //
33.m: In the north-east one should worship [him] as Viśvaksena, whose self is the universe. / One should bind a protective thread on the right hand of the god:

33.s:
saṃvatsarakṛtācāryāḥ sampūrṇaphaladāyine /
pavitrārohaṇāyedaṃ kautukaṃ dhāraya oṃ namaḥ //
33.d:
संवत्सरकृताचार्याः सम्पूर्णफलदायिने /
पवित्रारोहणायेदं कौतुकं धारय ओं नमः //
33.m: 'O teacher [of rites] performed through the year, who grants complete fruit, / wear this festive cord for the investiture with sacred thread! Oṃ homage!'

33.s:
upavāsādiniyamaṃ kuryādvai devasannidhau /
upavāsādiniyato devaṃ santoṣayāmyaham //
33.d:
उपवासादिनियमं कुर्याद्वै देवसन्निधौ /
उपवासादिनियतो देवं सन्तोषयाम्यहम् //
33.m: One should undertake the observance of fasting and the like in the presence of the god: / 'Observant of fasting and other [disciplines], I please the god.

33.s:
kāmakrodhādayaḥ sarve mā me tiṣṭhantu sarvathā /
adyaprabhṛti deveśa yāvadvaiśeṣikaṃ dinam //
33.d:
कामक्रोधादयः सर्वे मा मे तिष्ठन्तु सर्वथा /
अद्यप्रभृति देवेश यावद्वैशेषिकं दिनम् //
33.m: May lust, anger, and all others never abide in me / from this day forward, O Lord of gods, until the special day!'

33.s:
yajamāno hy aśaktaścet kuryānnaktādikaṃ vratī /
hutvā visarjayet stutvā śrīkarannityapūjanam //
oṃ hrīṃ(1) śrīṃ śrīdharāya trailokyamohanāya namaḥ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pavitrārohaṇe
śrīdharanityapūjākathanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśodhyāyaḥ
:ś atha catustriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
homādividhiḥ
33.d:
यजमानो ह्य् अशक्तश्चेत् कुर्यान्नक्तादिकं व्रती /
हुत्वा विसर्जयेत् स्तुत्वा श्रीकरन्नित्यपूजनम् //
ओं ह्रीं(1) श्रीं श्रीधराय त्रैलोक्यमोहनाय नमः //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये पवित्रारोहणे
श्रीधरनित्यपूजाकथनं नाम त्रयस्त्रिंशोध्यायः
:श् अथ चतुस्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
होमादिविधिः
33.m:
If the patron is unable, the observer of the votive observance may perform [the observance of eating only] at night and the like. / Having offered fire oblations and praised [him], one should dismiss [him]. The daily worship that brings prosperity [is]: / 'Oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ homage to Śrīdhara, who enchants the three worlds!'
:e Thus in the first great Purāṇa, the Āgneya, in [the section on] investiture with sacred thread, the thirty-third chapter, called 'Instruction on the Daily Worship of Śrīdhara.'
:ś Now, the thirty-fourth chapter:
The Rules for Fire Oblations and Other Rites.

34.s:
agnir uvāca
viśedanena mantreṇa yāgasthānañca bhūṣayet /
namo brahmaṇyadevāya śrīdharāyāvyayātmane //
:n
1 oṃ krīmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 99
34.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
विशेदनेन मन्त्रेण यागस्थानञ्च भूषयेत् /
नमो ब्रह्मण्यदेवाय श्रीधरायाव्ययात्मने //
:न्
1 ओं क्रीमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 99
34.m:
Agni said: / One should enter with this mantra and adorn the sacrificial area: / 'Homage to the god devoted to the Brahman, to Śrīdhara, the imperishable self,
:n
1. "oṃ krīm" is the variant reading in manuscript kha. / :p 99

34.s:
ṛgyajuḥsāmarūpāya śabdadehāya /
vilikhya maṇḍalaṃ sāyaṃ yāgadravyādi cāharet //
34.d:
ऋग्यजुःसामरूपाय शब्ददेहाय /
विलिख्य मण्डलं सायं यागद्रव्यादि चाहरेत् //
34.m: whose form is the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas, whose body is sound!' / Having drawn a maṇḍala in the evening, one should bring the sacrificial substances and other requisites.

34.s:
prakṣālitakarāṅghriḥ san vinyasyārghyakaro naraḥ /
arghyādibhistu śiraḥ prokṣya dvāradeśādikaṃ yathā //
34.d:
प्रक्षालितकराङ्घ्रिः सन् विन्यस्यार्घ्यकरो नरः /
अर्घ्यादिभिस्तु शिरः प्रोक्ष्य द्वारदेशादिकं यथा //
34.m: Having washed his hands and feet, performing the ritual depositions with a water offering in hand, / and having sprinkled his head, the doorway, and the rest with the water offering and other substances,

34.s:
ārabhed dvārayāgañca toraṇeśān prapūjayet /
aśvatthodumbaravaṭaprakṣāḥ pūrvādigā nagāḥ //
34.d:
आरभेद् द्वारयागञ्च तोरणेशान् प्रपूजयेत् /
अश्वत्थोदुम्बरवटप्रक्षाः पूर्वादिगा नगाः //
34.m: he should begin the sacrifice of the doorways and worship the lords of the archways. / The trees in the east and the other [directions] are the aśvattha, udumbara, vaṭa, and plakṣa.

34.s:
ṛgindraśobhanaṃ prāsyāṃ yujuryamasubhadrakam /
sāmāpaś ca sudhanvākhyaṃ somātharvasuhotrakam //
34.d:
ऋगिन्द्रशोभनं प्रास्यां युजुर्यमसुभद्रकम् /
सामापश् च सुधन्वाख्यं सोमाथर्वसुहोत्रकम् //
34.m: In the east [are] the Ṛgveda, Indra, and Śobhana; the Yajurveda, Yama, and Subhadraka; / the Sāmaveda, Varuṇa, and the one named Sudhanvan; Soma, the Atharvaveda, and Suhotraka.

34.s:
toraṇāntaḥ patākāś ca kumudādyā ghaṭadvayam /
dvāri dvāri svanāmnārcyāḥ pūrve pūrṇaś ca puṣkaraḥ //
34.d:
तोरणान्तः पताकाश् च कुमुदाद्या घटद्वयम् /
द्वारि द्वारि स्वनाम्नार्च्याः पूर्वे पूर्णश् च पुष्करः //
34.m: Inside the archways are banners, and Kumuda and others, with a pair of pitchers / to be worshipped by their own names at each door: Pūrṇa and Puṣkara in the east;

34.s:
ānandanandanau dakṣe vīrasenaḥ suṣeṇakaḥ /
sambhavaprabhavau saumye dvārapāṃś caiva pūjayet //
34.d:
आनन्दनन्दनौ दक्षे वीरसेनः सुषेणकः /
सम्भवप्रभवौ सौम्ये द्वारपांश् चैव पूजयेत् //
34.m: Ānanda and Nandana in the south; Vīrasena and Suṣeṇa; / Sambhava and Prabhava in the north; and one should also worship the door-keepers.

34.s:
astrajaptapuṣpakṣepādvighnānutsārya saṃviśet /
bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāyātha vinyasya kṛtamudravaḥ //
34.d:
अस्त्रजप्तपुष्पक्षेपाद्विघ्नानुत्सार्य संविशेत् /
भूतशुद्धिं विधायाथ विन्यस्य कृतमुद्रवः //
34.m: Having dispelled obstacles by throwing flowers consecrated with the weapon-mantra, one should enter. / Then, having performed the purification of elements, having made the ritual depositions, and having formed the ritual gestures,

34.s:
phaṭkārāntāṃ śikhāṃ japtvā sarṣapān dikṣu nikṣipet /
vāsudevena gomūtraṃ saṅkarṣaṇena gomayam //
34.d:
फट्कारान्तां शिखां जप्त्वा सर्षपान् दिक्षु निक्षिपेत् /
वासुदेवेन गोमूत्रं सङ्कर्षणेन गोमयम् //
34.m: having recited the crest-mantra ending in phaṭ, one should scatter mustard seeds in all directions. / [One should take] cow's urine with the Vāsudeva [mantra], and cow dung with the Saṅkarṣaṇa [mantra];

34.s:
pradyumnena payastajjāt dadhi nārāyaṇād ghṛtam /
ekadvitryādivārāṇi ghṛtādvai bhāgatodhikam //
34.d:
प्रद्युम्नेन पयस्तज्जात् दधि नारायणाद् घृतम् /
एकद्वित्र्यादिवाराणि घृताद्वै भागतोधिकम् //
34.m: milk with the Pradyumna [mantra], curd produced from it, and ghee with the Nārāyaṇa [mantra]. / One, two, three, or more times, each portion increasing from the ghee,

34.s:
ghṛtapātre tadekatra pañcagavyamudāhṛtam /
maṇḍapaprokṣaṇāyaikañcāparamprāśanāya ca //
34.d:
घृतपात्रे तदेकत्र पञ्चगव्यमुदाहृतम् /
मण्डपप्रोक्षणायैकञ्चापरम्प्राशनाय च //
34.m: gathered together in the ghee vessel, that is called the five cow-products: / one [portion] for sprinkling the pavilion and another for drinking.

34.s:
ānīya daśakumbheṣu indrādyān lokapān yajet /
pūjyājñāṃ śrāvayettāṃś ca sthātavyaṃ cājñayā hareḥ //
34.d:
आनीय दशकुम्भेषु इन्द्राद्यान् लोकपान् यजेत् /
पूज्याज्ञां श्रावयेत्तांश् च स्थातव्यं चाज्ञया हरेः //
34.m: Having brought [them] in ten water jars, one should worship Indra and the other world guardians; / and having worshipped them, one should announce the command to them: 'You must remain here by Hari's command!'

34.s:
yāgadravyādi saṃrakṣya vikirān vikirettataḥ /
mūlāṣṭaśatasañjaptān kuśakūrcān hareś ca tān //
34.d:
यागद्रव्यादि संरक्ष्य विकिरान् विकिरेत्ततः /
मूलाष्टशतसञ्जप्तान् कुशकूर्चान् हरेश् च तान् //
34.m: Having protected the sacrificial substances and other requisites, one should then scatter the grain scatterings / and Hari's bundles of kuśa grass consecrated eight hundred times with the root-mantra.

34.s:
aiśānyāṃ diśi tatrasthaṃ sthāpyaṃ kumbhañca vardhanīṃ /
:p 100
kumbhe sāṅgaṃ hariṃ prārcya vardhanyāmastramarcayet //
34.d:
ऐशान्यां दिशि तत्रस्थं स्थाप्यं कुम्भञ्च वर्धनीं /
:प् 100
कुम्भे साङ्गं हरिं प्रार्च्य वर्धन्यामस्त्रमर्चयेत् //
34.m:
In the north-eastern direction one should place the water jar and the vardhanī vessel standing there.
:p 100
Having worshipped Hari with his limbs in the jar, one should worship the weapon in the vardhanī vessel.

34.s:
pradakṣiṇaṃ yāgagṛhaṃ vardhanyācchinnadhārayā /
siñcannayettataḥ kumbhaṃ pūjayecca sthirāsane //
34.d:
प्रदक्षिणं यागगृहं वर्धन्याच्छिन्नधारया /
सिञ्चन्नयेत्ततः कुम्भं पूजयेच्च स्थिरासने //
34.m: Circling clockwise around the sacrificial pavilion with the continuous stream from the vardhanī vessel, / sprinkling as he carries it, he should then worship the jar on a steady seat.

34.s:
sapañcaratnavastrāḍhyakumbhe gandhādibhirharim /
vardhanyāṃ hemagarbhāyāṃ yajedastrañca vāmataḥ //
34.d:
सपञ्चरत्नवस्त्राढ्यकुम्भे गन्धादिभिर्हरिम् /
वर्धन्यां हेमगर्भायां यजेदस्त्रञ्च वामतः //
34.m: In the jar supplied with the five gems and a cloth, [one should worship] Hari with perfumes and other offerings, / and in the vardhanī containing gold, one should worship the weapon on the left.

34.s:
tatsamīpe vāstulakṣmīṃ bhūvināyakamarcayet /
srapanaṃ kalpayedviṣṇoḥ saṅkrāntyādau tathaiva ca //
34.d:
तत्समीपे वास्तुलक्ष्मीं भूविनायकमर्चयेत् /
स्रपनं कल्पयेद्विष्णोः सङ्क्रान्त्यादौ तथैव च //
34.m: Near that, one should worship Vāstulakṣmī, the Earth, and Vināyaka. / One should likewise prepare Viṣṇu's ablution at the solar ingress and other [occasions],

34.s: pūrṇakumbhān nava sthāpya navakoṇeṣu nirbraṇān //
34.d: पूर्णकुम्भान् नव स्थाप्य नवकोणेषु निर्ब्रणान् //
34.m: having placed nine unblemished, full jars at the nine corners.

34.s:
pūrvādikalasegnyādau pañcāmṛtajalādikam /
dadhi kṣīraṃ madhūṣṇīdaṃ pādyaṃ syāccaturaṅgakam //
34.d:
पूर्वादिकलसेग्न्यादौ पञ्चामृतजलादिकम् /
दधि क्षीरं मधूष्णीदं पाद्यं स्याच्चतुरङ्गकम् //
34.m: In the jars starting from the east and south-east are the five nectars, water, and so forth: / curd, milk, honey, and warm water. The foot-washing water should have four constituents:

34.s:
padmaśyāmākadūrvāś ca viṣṇupatnī ca pādyakam /
tathāṣṭāṅgārghyamākhyātaṃ yavagandhaphalākṣatam //
34.d:
पद्मश्यामाकदूर्वाश् च विष्णुपत्नी च पाद्यकम् /
तथाष्टाङ्गार्घ्यमाख्यातं यवगन्धफलाक्षतम् //
34.m: lotus, śyāmāka grain, dūrvā grass, and viṣṇupatnī make up the foot-washing water. / Likewise, the water offering of eight constituents is said to be barley, perfume, fruit, unbroken rice,

34.s:
kuśāḥ siddhārthapuṣpāni tilā dravyāṇi cārhaṇam(1) /
lavaṅgakakkolayute dadyādācamanīyakam //
34.d:
कुशाः सिद्धार्थपुष्पानि तिला द्रव्याणि चार्हणम्(1) /
लवङ्गकक्कोलयुते दद्यादाचमनीयकम् //
34.m: kuśa grass, white mustard seeds, flowers, sesame seeds, and articles of worship. / One should offer the water for sipping containing cloves and cubeb berries.

34.s:
snāpayenmūlamantreṇa devaṃ pañcāmṛtair api /
śuddhodaṃ madhyakumbhena devamūrdhni viniḥkṣipet //
34.d:
स्नापयेन्मूलमन्त्रेण देवं पञ्चामृतैर् अपि /
शुद्धोदं मध्यकुम्भेन देवमूर्ध्नि विनिःक्षिपेत् //
34.m: One should bathe the god with the root-mantra using the five nectars as well; / with the central jar, one should pour pure water over the god's head.

34.s:
kalaśānniḥsṛtaṃ toyaṃ kūrcāgraṃ(2) saṃspṛśennaraḥ /
śuddhodakena pādyañca arghyamācamanandadet //
34.d:
कलशान्निःसृतं तोयं कूर्चाग्रं(2) संस्पृशेन्नरः /
शुद्धोदकेन पाद्यञ्च अर्घ्यमाचमनन्ददेत् //
34.m: A person should touch the water flowing from the jar with the tip of a bundle of grass. / With pure water he should offer foot-washing water, the water offering, and water for sipping.

34.s:
parimṛjya paṭenāṅgaṃ savastraṃ maṇḍalaṃ nayet /
tatrābhyarcyācareddhomaṃ kuṇḍādau prāṇasaṃyamī //
34.d:
परिमृज्य पटेनाङ्गं सवस्त्रं मण्डलं नयेत् /
तत्राभ्यर्च्याचरेद्धोमं कुण्डादौ प्राणसंयमी //
34.m: Having wiped the limbs with a cloth, he should bring [the image] with its garments to the maṇḍala. / Having worshipped it there, one who controls his breath should perform the fire oblation in the fire-pit and other places.

34.s:
prakṣālya hastau rekhāś ca tisraḥ pūrvāgragāminīḥ /
:n
1 cārhaṇā iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 dūrvāgramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 101
dakṣiṇāduttarāś ca tisraś caivaottarāgragāḥ //
34.d:
प्रक्षाल्य हस्तौ रेखाश् च तिस्रः पूर्वाग्रगामिनीः /
:न्
1 चार्हणा इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 दूर्वाग्रमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 101
दक्षिणादुत्तराश् च तिस्रश् चैवओत्तराग्रगाः //
34.m:
Having washed his hands, [he draws] three lines running towards the east,
:n
1. "cārhaṇā" is the variant reading in both manuscripts kha and ṅa.
2. "dūrvāgram" is the variant reading in manuscript ṅa. / :p 101
and from south to north, three lines running towards the north.

34.s:
arghyodakena samprokṣya yonimudrāmpradarśayet /
dhyātvāgnirūpañcāgnintu yonyāṃ kuṇḍe kṣipennaraḥ //
34.d:
अर्घ्योदकेन सम्प्रोक्ष्य योनिमुद्राम्प्रदर्शयेत् /
ध्यात्वाग्निरूपञ्चाग्निन्तु योन्यां कुण्डे क्षिपेन्नरः //
34.m: Having sprinkled them with water from the water offering, he should display the yoni ritual gesture. / Having meditated on Agni's form, a person should cast the fire into the womb of the fire-pit.

34.s:
pātrāṇyāsādayet paścāddarbhaśrukśruvakādibhiḥ /
bāhumātrāḥ paridhaya idhmavraś canameva ca //
34.d:
पात्राण्यासादयेत् पश्चाद्दर्भश्रुक्श्रुवकादिभिः /
बाहुमात्राः परिधय इध्मव्रश् चनमेव च //
34.m: Then he should set out the vessels with darbha grass, the śruc, the śruva, and other ladles; / the enclosure sticks measuring an arm's length, and the firewood pieces trimmed [to measure];

34.s:
praṇītā prokṣaṇīpātramājyasthālī ghṛtādikam /
prasthadvayaṃ taṇḍulānāṃ yugmaṃ yugmamadhomukham //
34.d:
प्रणीता प्रोक्षणीपात्रमाज्यस्थाली घृतादिकम् /
प्रस्थद्वयं तण्डुलानां युग्मं युग्ममधोमुखम् //
34.m: the praṇītā vessel, the prokṣaṇī vessel, the clarified butter bowl, ghee, and the rest; / two prastha measures of rice grains, placed in pairs face down.

34.s:
praṇītāprokṣaṇīpātre nyaset prāgagragaṃ kuśam /
adbhiḥ pūryapraṇītāntu dhyātvā devaṃ prapūjya ca //
34.d:
प्रणीताप्रोक्षणीपात्रे न्यसेत् प्रागग्रगं कुशम् /
अद्भिः पूर्यप्रणीतान्तु ध्यात्वा देवं प्रपूज्य च //
34.m: In the praṇītā and prokṣaṇī vessels he should place kuśa grass pointing eastward. / Having filled the praṇītā with water, and having meditated upon and worshipped the god,

34.s:
praṇītāṃ sthāpayedagre dravyāṇāñcaiva madhyataḥ /
prokṣaṇīmadbhiḥ sampūrya prārcya dakṣe tu vinyaset //
34.d:
प्रणीतां स्थापयेदग्रे द्रव्याणाञ्चैव मध्यतः /
प्रोक्षणीमद्भिः सम्पूर्य प्रार्च्य दक्षे तु विन्यसेत् //
34.m: he should place the praṇītā in front, right in the middle of the implements. / Having filled the prokṣaṇī with water and worshipped it, he should place it on the right.

34.s:
caruñca śrapayedagnau brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset /
kuśānāstīrya pūrvādau paridhīn sthāpayettataḥ //
34.d:
चरुञ्च श्रपयेदग्नौ ब्रह्माणं दक्षिणे न्यसेत् /
कुशानास्तीर्य पूर्वादौ परिधीन् स्थापयेत्ततः //
34.m: He should cook the sacrificial porridge on the fire and place Brahmā to the south. / Having spread kuśa grass in the east and other directions, he should then lay down the enclosure sticks.

34.s:
vaiṣṇavīkaraṇaṃ kuryād garbhādhānādinā naraḥ /
garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanañjaniḥ //
34.d:
वैष्णवीकरणं कुर्याद् गर्भाधानादिना नरः /
गर्भाधानं पुंसवनं सीमन्तोन्नयनञ्जनिः //
34.m: A man should perform the Vaiṣṇava consecration [of the fire] through the rites of conception and the rest: / conception, the rite for procuring a male child, the parting of the hair, birth,

34.s:
nāmādisamāvartanāntaṃ juhuyādaṣṭa cāhutīḥ /
pūrṇāhutīḥ pratikarma śrucā sruvasuyuktayā //
34.d:
नामादिसमावर्तनान्तं जुहुयादष्ट चाहुतीः /
पूर्णाहुतीः प्रतिकर्म श्रुचा स्रुवसुयुक्तया //
34.m: and the rites ending with the return home from studenthood, offering eight oblations, / and full oblations for each rite with the ladle joined with the dipping ladle.

34.s:
kuṇḍamadhye ṛtumatīṃ lakṣmīṃ sañcintya homayet /
kuṇḍalakṣmīḥ samākhyātā prakṛtistriguṇātmakā //
34.d:
कुण्डमध्ये ऋतुमतीं लक्ष्मीं सञ्चिन्त्य होमयेत् /
कुण्डलक्ष्मीः समाख्याता प्रकृतिस्त्रिगुणात्मका //
34.m: Having meditated upon Lakṣmī in her fertile period within the fire-pit, he should make oblations. / The Lakṣmī of the fire-pit is described as material nature consisting of the three qualities.

34.s:
sā yoniḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ vidyāmantragaṇasya ca /
vimukteḥ kāraṇaṃ vahniḥ paramātmā ca muktidaḥ //
34.d:
सा योनिः सर्वभूतानां विद्यामन्त्रगणस्य च /
विमुक्तेः कारणं वह्निः परमात्मा च मुक्तिदः //
34.m: She is the womb of all beings and of the multitude of sciences and mantras. / Fire is the cause of liberation, and the Supreme Self is the giver of liberation.

34.s:
prācyāṃ śiraḥ samākhyātaṃ bāhū koṇe vyavasthitau /
īśānāgneyakoṇe tu jaṅghe vāyavyanairṛte //
34.d:
प्राच्यां शिरः समाख्यातं बाहू कोणे व्यवस्थितौ /
ईशानाग्नेयकोणे तु जङ्घे वायव्यनैरृते //
34.m: Her head is declared to be in the east; her two arms are placed in the corners: / in the northeast and southeast corners, and her two shanks in the northwest and southwest.

34.s:
udaraṃ kuṇḍamityuktaṃ yoniryonirvidhīyate /
guṇatrayaṃ mekhalāḥ syurdhyātvaivaṃ samidho daśa //
:p 102
34.d:
उदरं कुण्डमित्युक्तं योनिर्योनिर्विधीयते /
गुणत्रयं मेखलाः स्युर्ध्यात्वैवं समिधो दश //
:प् 102
34.m:
The fire-pit is called the belly; the pit's vulva is prescribed as her vulva. / The three tiers are the three qualities. Having meditated thus, ten sticks of sacrificial fuel,
[Page 102]

34.s:
pañcādhikāṃstu juhuyāt praṇavānmuṣṭimudrayā(1) /
punarāghārau juhuyādvāyvagnyantaṃ tataḥ śrapet //
34.d:
पञ्चाधिकांस्तु जुहुयात् प्रणवान्मुष्टिमुद्रया(1) /
पुनराघारौ जुहुयाद्वाय्वग्न्यन्तं ततः श्रपेत् //
34.m: increased by five [more], he should offer with the praṇava using the fist gesture. / Again he should offer the two introductory oblations of clarified butter up to the northwest and southeast, and then cook [the oblation].

34.s:
īśāntaṃ mūlamantreṇa ājyabhāgau tu homayet /
uttare dvādaśāntena dakṣiṇe tena madhyataḥ //
34.d:
ईशान्तं मूलमन्त्रेण आज्यभागौ तु होमयेत् /
उत्तरे द्वादशान्तेन दक्षिणे तेन मध्यतः //
34.m: He should offer the two portions of clarified butter up to the northeast with the root mantra: / in the north with the twelve-syllable [mantra], in the south with that [same mantra], and in the middle

34.s:
vyāhṛtyā padmamadhyasthaṃ dhyāyedvahnintu saṃskṛtam /
vaiṣṇavaṃ saptajihvaṃ ca sūryakoṭisamaprabham //
34.d:
व्याहृत्या पद्ममध्यस्थं ध्यायेद्वह्निन्तु संस्कृतम् /
वैष्णवं सप्तजिह्वं च सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम् //
34.m: with the vyāhṛtis. He should meditate on the consecrated fire situated in the center of the lotus, / related to Viṣṇu, seven-tongued, possessing the radiance of ten million suns,

34.s:
candravaktrañca(2) sūryākṣaṃ juhuyācchatamaṣṭa ca /
tadardhañcāṣṭa mūlena aṅgānāñca daśāṃśataḥ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye agnikāryakathanaṃ nāma caturtriṃśo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
pavitrādhivāsanādividhiḥ
34.d:
चन्द्रवक्त्रञ्च(2) सूर्याक्षं जुहुयाच्छतमष्ट च /
तदर्धञ्चाष्ट मूलेन अङ्गानाञ्च दशांशतः //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये अग्निकार्यकथनं नाम चतुर्त्रिंशो
ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ पञ्चत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
पवित्राधिवासनादिविधिः
34.m:
with a moon-like face and sun-like eyes; and he should offer one hundred and eight [oblations], / or half of that, and eight with the root mantra, and for the limbs a tenth part.
Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter, entitled "The Description of Fire Rites," in the venerable and great Āgneyapurāṇa.
Now, the thirty-fifth chapter:
The Rule for the Preliminary Consecration of the Sacred Cord and Related Rites

35.s:
agnir uvāca
sampātāhutināsicya(2) pavitrāṇyadhivāsayet /
nṛsiṃhamantrajaptāni guptānyastreṇa tāni tu //
35.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
सम्पाताहुतिनासिच्य(2) पवित्राण्यधिवासयेत् /
नृसिंहमन्त्रजप्तानि गुप्तान्यस्त्रेण तानि तु //
35.m: Agni said: / Having sprinkled [them] with oblation-drops, he should perform the preliminary consecration of the sacred cords / over which the Nṛsiṃha mantra has been recited and which are protected with the weapon mantra.

35.s:
vastrasaṃveṣṭitānyeva pātrasthānyabhimantrayet /
vilvādyadbhiḥ prokṣitāni mantreṇa caikadhā dvidhā(4) //
35.d:
वस्त्रसंवेष्टितान्येव पात्रस्थान्यभिमन्त्रयेत् /
विल्वाद्यद्भिः प्रोक्षितानि मन्त्रेण चैकधा द्विधा(4) //
35.m: He should consecrate them with mantras while they are wrapped in cloth and kept in a vessel, / sprinkled with water containing bilva and other leaves, singly or doubly with the mantra.

35.s:
kumbhapārśve tu saṃsthāpya rakṣāṃ vijñāpya deśikaḥ /
dantakāṣṭhañcāmarakaṃ pūrve saṅkarṣaṇena tu //
35.d:
कुम्भपार्श्वे तु संस्थाप्य रक्षां विज्ञाप्य देशिकः /
दन्तकाष्ठञ्चामरकं पूर्वे सङ्कर्षणेन तु //
35.m: Placing them beside the water jar and announcing protection, the ritual master [should place] / a tooth-stick and a chowrie in the east with [the mantra of] Saṅkarṣaṇa;

35.s:
pradyumnena bhasmatilān dakṣe gomayamṛttikāṃ /
:n
1 svastimudrayeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 pañcavaktraṃśceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 saṅghātāhutināsicyeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 mantrāṇāṃ caikadhā dvidheti kha, cihinitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 103
vāruṇena cāniruddhena saumye nārāyaṇena ca //
35.d:
प्रद्युम्नेन भस्मतिलान् दक्षे गोमयमृत्तिकां /
:न्
1 स्वस्तिमुद्रयेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 पञ्चवक्त्रंश्चेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 सङ्घाताहुतिनासिच्येति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 मन्त्राणां चैकधा द्विधेति ख, चिहिनितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 103
वारुणेन चानिरुद्धेन सौम्ये नारायणेन च //
35.m:
with [the mantra of] Pradyumna, ashes and sesame seeds, and cow-dung and earth in the south;
[Notes]
1. "svastimudrayā" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2. "pañcavaktraṃśca" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
3. "saṅghātāhutināsicya" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
4. "mantrāṇāṃ caikadhā dvidhā" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / [Page 103]
in the west with [the mantra of] Aniruddha; and in the north with [the mantra of] Nārāyaṇa.

35.s:
darbhodakañcātha hṛdā agnau kuṅkumarocanaṃ /
aiśānyāṃ śirasā dhūpaṃ śikhayā nairṛtepyatha //
35.d:
दर्भोदकञ्चाथ हृदा अग्नौ कुङ्कुमरोचनं /
ऐशान्यां शिरसा धूपं शिखया नैरृतेप्यथ //
35.m: And water with darbha grass with the heart mantra; in the southeast, saffron and rocanā; / in the northeast, incense with the head mantra; and with the crest mantra in the southwest;

35.s:
mūlapuṣpāṇi divyāni kavacenātha vāyave /
candanāmbvakṣatadadhidūrvāś ca puṭikāsthitāḥ //
35.d:
मूलपुष्पाणि दिव्यानि कवचेनाथ वायवे /
चन्दनाम्ब्वक्षतदधिदूर्वाश् च पुटिकास्थिताः //
35.m: celestial root flowers with the armor mantra in the northwest; / and sandalwood water, unbroken grains, yogurt, and dūrvā grass placed in leaf-cups.

35.s:
gṛhaṃ trisūtreṇāveṣṭya punaḥ siddhārthakān kṣipet /
dadyātpūjākrameṇātha svaiḥ svair gandhapavitrakaṃ //
35.d:
गृहं त्रिसूत्रेणावेष्ट्य पुनः सिद्धार्थकान् क्षिपेत् /
दद्यात्पूजाक्रमेणाथ स्वैः स्वैर् गन्धपवित्रकं //
35.m: Having enclosed the house with a three-fold cord, he should scatter white mustard seeds again. / Then, according to the order of worship, he should offer the fragrant sacred cord with each respective

35.s:
mantrair vai dvārapādibhyo viṣṇukumbhe tvanena ca /
viṣṇutejobhavaṃ ramyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanaṃ //
35.d:
मन्त्रैर् वै द्वारपादिभ्यो विष्णुकुम्भे त्वनेन च /
विष्णुतेजोभवं रम्यं सर्वपातकनाशनं //
35.m: mantra to the door-guardians and others; and on Viṣṇu's jar with this [mantra]: / "O God, born of Viṣṇu's splendor, delightful, destroyer of all sins,

35.s:
sarvakāmapradaṃ devaṃ tavāṅge dhārayāmyahaṃ /
sampūjya dhūpadīpādyair vrajeddvārasamīpataḥ //
35.d:
सर्वकामप्रदं देवं तवाङ्गे धारयाम्यहं /
सम्पूज्य धूपदीपाद्यैर् व्रजेद्द्वारसमीपतः //
35.m: granter of all desires, I place [this cord] upon your limb!" / Having worshiped with incense, lamps, and the like, he should approach the door.

35.s:
gandhapuṣpākṣatopetaṃ pavitrañcākhilerpayet (1) /
pavitraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tejo mahāpātakanāśanaṃ //
35.d:
गन्धपुष्पाक्षतोपेतं पवित्रञ्चाखिलेर्पयेत् (1) /
पवित्रं वैष्णवं तेजो महापातकनाशनं //
35.m: He should offer the sacred cord, provided with sandalwood paste, flowers, and unbroken grains, to the universe: / "The sacred cord is Vaiṣṇava splendor, the destroyer of great sins;

35.s:
dharmakāmārthasiddhyarthaṃ svakeṅge dhārayāmyahaṃ /
āsane parivārādau gurau dadyāt pavitrakaṃ //
35.d:
धर्मकामार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं स्वकेङ्गे धारयाम्यहं /
आसने परिवारादौ गुरौ दद्यात् पवित्रकं //
35.m: for the accomplishment of righteousness, desire, and worldly wealth, I place it upon my own limb!" / He should offer the sacred cord upon the seat, to the retinue, and to the teacher.

Having worshiped with perfume and other offerings, endowed with perfume, flowers, unbroken grains, and the like, / he should offer [it] to Hari with the root mantra beginning with "O born of Viṣṇu's splendor!"

35.s:
vahnisthāya tato datvā devaṃ samprārthayettataḥ /
kṣīrodadhimahānāgaśayyāvasthitavigrahaḥ //
35.d:
वह्निस्थाय ततो दत्वा देवं सम्प्रार्थयेत्ततः /
क्षीरोदधिमहानागशय्यावस्थितविग्रहः //
35.m: Then, having given [it] to the one situated in the fire, he should pray to the God: / "O Keśava, whose body rests upon the couch of the great serpent in the ocean of milk,

35.s:
prātastvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi sannidhau bhava keśava /
indrādibhastato datvā viṣṇupārṣadake baliṃ //
35.d:
प्रातस्त्वां पूजयिष्यामि सन्निधौ भव केशव /
इन्द्रादिभस्ततो दत्वा विष्णुपार्षदके बलिं //
35.m: I shall worship you in the morning; be present here!" / Then, having given the oblation to Indra and the others, and to the attendants of Viṣṇu,
then [he should place] in front of the deity a jar provided with a pair of cloths, / filled with water containing rocanā, camphor, saffron, perfumes, and other substances;

35.s:
gandhapuṣpādinābhūṣya mūlamantreṇa pūjayet /
:n
1 pavitraṃ pārśvato nayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 104
maṇḍapādvahirāgatya vilipte maṇḍalatraye //
35.d:
गन्धपुष्पादिनाभूष्य मूलमन्त्रेण पूजयेत् /
:न्
1 पवित्रं पार्श्वतो नयेदिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 104
मण्डपाद्वहिरागत्य विलिप्ते मण्डलत्रये //
35.m:
having adorned it with fragrant paste, flowers, and the like, he should worship it with the root mantra.
[Notes]
1. "pavitraṃ pārśvato nayet" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [Page 104]
Having come outside the pavilion, upon three smeared mandalas,

35.s:
pañcagavyañcarundantakāṣṭhañcaiva kramādbhavet /
purāṇaśravaṇaṃ stotraṃ paṭhan jāgaraṇaṃ niśi //
35.d:
पञ्चगव्यञ्चरुन्दन्तकाष्ठञ्चैव क्रमाद्भवेत् /
पुराणश्रवणं स्तोत्रं पठन् जागरणं निशि //
35.m: the five products of the cow, the sacrificial porridge, and the tooth-stick should be [placed] in order. / Hearing Purāṇas, reciting hymns, and keeping vigil during the night [should be observed].

35.s:
parapreṣakabālānāṃ strīṇāṃ bhogabhujāṃ tathā /
sadyodhivāsanaṃ kuryādvinā gandhapavitrakaṃ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pavitrādhivāsanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha ṣaṭtriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
pavitrāropaṇavidhānaṃ
35.d:
परप्रेषकबालानां स्त्रीणां भोगभुजां तथा /
सद्योधिवासनं कुर्याद्विना गन्धपवित्रकं //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये पवित्राधिवासनं नाम पञ्चत्रिंशो
ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ षट्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
पवित्रारोपणविधानं
35.m:
For servants of others, children, women, and sensualists, / one should perform immediate preliminary consecration without the fragrant sacred cord.
Thus ends the thirty-fifth chapter, entitled "The Preliminary Consecration of the Sacred Cord," in the venerable and great Āgneyapurāṇa.
Now, the thirty-sixth chapter:
The Rule for the Investiture with the Sacred Cord

36.s:
agnir uvāca
prātaḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā dvārapālān(1) prapūjya ca /
praviśya gupte deśe ca samākṛṣyātha dhārayet //
36.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
प्रातः स्नानं कृत्वा द्वारपालान्(1) प्रपूज्य च /
प्रविश्य गुप्ते देशे च समाकृष्याथ धारयेत् //
36.m: Agni said: / Having bathed in the morning and worshiped the door-guardians, / and having entered a secluded place, he should draw forth and take up

36.s:
pūrvādhivāsitaṃ dravyaṃ vastrābharaṇagandhakaṃ /
nirasya sarvanirmālyaṃ devaṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet //
36.d:
पूर्वाधिवासितं द्रव्यं वस्त्राभरणगन्धकं /
निरस्य सर्वनिर्माल्यं देवं संस्थाप्य पूजयेत् //
36.m: the material previously consecrated preliminarily—cloth, ornament, and perfume. / Having removed all the remnants of previous offerings and installed the deity, he should worship [Him]

36.s:
pañcāmṛtaiḥ kaṣāyaiś ca śuddhagandhodakaistataḥ /
pūrvādhivāsitaṃ dadyādvastraṃ gandhaṃ ca puṣpakaṃ //
36.d:
पञ्चामृतैः कषायैश् च शुद्धगन्धोदकैस्ततः /
पूर्वाधिवासितं दद्याद्वस्त्रं गन्धं च पुष्पकं //
36.m: with the five nectars, herbal decoctions, and pure scented waters. / Then he should offer the previously consecrated cloth, perfume, and flowers.

36.s:
agnau hutvā nityavacca devaṃ samprārthayennamet (2) /
samarpya karma devāya pūjāṃ naimittikīṃ caret //
36.d:
अग्नौ हुत्वा नित्यवच्च देवं सम्प्रार्थयेन्नमेत् (2) /
समर्प्य कर्म देवाय पूजां नैमित्तिकीं चरेत् //
36.m: Having made offerings in the fire as in the daily rite, he should pray to the deity and bow. / Having surrendered the rite to the God, he should perform the occasional worship.

36.s:
dvārapālaviṣṇukumbhavardhanīḥ prārthayeddhariṃ /
ato deveti mantreṇa mūlamantreṇa kumbhake //
36.d:
द्वारपालविष्णुकुम्भवर्धनीः प्रार्थयेद्धरिं /
अतो देवेति मन्त्रेण मूलमन्त्रेण कुम्भके //
36.m: He should pray to the door-guardians, Viṣṇu's jar, the vardhanī vessel, and Hari. / With the mantra "ato devā..." and with the root mantra on the jar:

36.s:
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ /
:n
1 lokapālāniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 prārthayennyasediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 105
pavitrīkaraṇārthāya varṣapūjāphalapradaṃ //
36.d:
कृष्ण कृष्ण नमस्तुभ्यं गृह्णीष्वेदं पवित्रकं /
:न्
1 लोकपालानिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 प्रार्थयेन्न्यसेदिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 105
पवित्रीकरणार्थाय वर्षपूजाफलप्रदं //
36.m:
"O Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, salutation to you! Accept this sacred cord
[Notes]
1. "lokapālān" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "prārthayennyaset" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga. / [Page 105]
for the sake of purification, which grants the fruit of a full year of worship!

36.s:
pavitrakaṃ kurudhvādya yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ /
śuddho bhavāmyahaṃ deva tvatprasādāt sureśvara //
36.d:
पवित्रकं कुरुध्वाद्य यन्मया दुष्कृतं कृतं /
शुद्धो भवाम्यहं देव त्वत्प्रसादात् सुरेश्वर //
36.m: Make pure today whatever evil deed has been done by me! / May I become pure, O God, O Lord of the gods, by your grace!"

36.s:
pavitrañca hṛdādyaistu ātmānamabhiṣicya ca /
viṣṇukumbhañca samprokṣya vrajeddevasamīpataḥ //
36.d:
पवित्रञ्च हृदाद्यैस्तु आत्मानमभिषिच्य च /
विष्णुकुम्भञ्च सम्प्रोक्ष्य व्रजेद्देवसमीपतः //
36.m: Having sprinkled the sacred cord and himself with the heart mantra and others, / and having sprinkled Viṣṇu's jar, he should go into the presence of the God.

36.s:
pavitramātmane dadyādrakṣābandhaṃ visṛjya ca(1) /
gṛhāṇa brahmasūtrañca yanmayā kalpitaṃ prabho //
36.d:
पवित्रमात्मने दद्याद्रक्षाबन्धं विसृज्य च(1) /
गृहाण ब्रह्मसूत्रञ्च यन्मया कल्पितं प्रभो //
36.m: He should give a sacred cord to himself and release the protective thread: / "Receive, O Lord, this sacred thread fashioned by me,

36.s:
karmaṇāṃ pūraṇārthāya yathā doṣo na me bhavet /
dvārapālāsanagurumukhyānāñca pavitrakam //
36.d:
कर्मणां पूरणार्थाय यथा दोषो न मे भवेत् /
द्वारपालासनगुरुमुख्यानाञ्च पवित्रकम् //
36.m: for the fulfillment of rites, so that no fault may accrue to me!" / [He should offer] a sacred cord to the door-guardians, the seat, the teacher, and the principal [deities].

36.s:
kaniṣṭādi ca devāya vanamālāñca mūlataḥ /
hṛdādiviśvaksenānte pavitrāṇi samarpayet //
36.d:
कनिष्टादि च देवाय वनमालाञ्च मूलतः /
हृदादिविश्वक्सेनान्ते पवित्राणि समर्पयेत् //
36.m: And [he should present] the smallest [thread] and so forth to the deity, and the garland of forest flowers with the root mantra; / he should offer the sacred threads beginning with the heart and ending with Viṣvaksena.

36.s:
vahnau hutvāgnivartibhyo viṣṇvādibhyaḥ pavitrakam /
prārcya pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāt prāyaścittāya mūlataḥ //
36.d:
वह्नौ हुत्वाग्निवर्तिभ्यो विष्ण्वादिभ्यः पवित्रकम् /
प्रार्च्य पूर्णाहुतिं दद्यात् प्रायश्चित्ताय मूलतः //
36.m: Having offered into the fire, having worshiped the sacred thread for those who dwell in the fire, beginning with Viṣṇu, / he should give the final full oblation with the root mantra for the sake of expiation.

36.s:
aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi pañcopaniṣadaistataḥ /
maṇividrumamālābhirmandārakusumādibhiḥ //
36.d:
अष्टोत्तरशतं वापि पञ्चोपनिषदैस्ततः /
मणिविद्रुममालाभिर्मन्दारकुसुमादिभिः //
36.m: Or a hundred and eight [oblations], then with the five Upaniṣads; / with garlands of gems and corals, with mandāra blossoms and other flowers:

36.s:
iyaṃ sāṃvatsarī pūjā tavāstu garuḍadhvaja /
vanamālā yathā deva kaustubhaṃ satataṃ hṛdi //
36.d:
इयं सांवत्सरी पूजा तवास्तु गरुडध्वज /
वनमाला यथा देव कौस्तुभं सततं हृदि //
36.m: "May this yearly worship belong to you, O you whose banner is Garuḍa! / Just as, O Lord, the garland of forest flowers and the Kaustubha [gem] are always on your heart,

36.s:
tadvat pavitratantūṃś ca pūjāṃ ca hṛdaye vaha(2) /
kāmato 'kāmato vāpi yatkṛtaṃ niyamārcane //
36.d:
तद्वत् पवित्रतन्तूंश् च पूजां च हृदये वह(2) /
कामतो ऽकामतो वापि यत्कृतं नियमार्चने //
36.m: so too bear the threads of the sacred thread and the worship upon your heart. / Whatever has been done intentionally or unintentionally in the ritual worship of my vow,

36.s:
vidhinā vighnalopena paripūrṇaṃ tadastu me /
prārthya natvā kṣamāpyātha pavitraṃ mastake 'rpayet //
36.d:
विधिना विघ्नलोपेन परिपूर्णं तदस्तु मे /
प्रार्थ्य नत्वा क्षमाप्याथ पवित्रं मस्तके ऽर्पयेत् //
36.m: may that become completely fulfilled for me according to rule despite the obstacle of omission." / Having prayed, bowed, and asked forgiveness, he should then place the sacred thread upon [his own] head.

36.s:
datvā baliṃ dakṣiṇābhirvaiṣṇavantoṣayedguruṃ /
:n
1 rakṣābandhaṃ vimucya ceti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / pavitraṃ
mūlato dadyādrakṣārthaṃ tadvisṛjya ceti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 pavitrakaṃ tvañca pūjāyāṃ hṛdaye vaheti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 106
viprān bhojanavastrādyair divasaṃ pakṣameva vā //
36.d:
दत्वा बलिं दक्षिणाभिर्वैष्णवन्तोषयेद्गुरुं /
:न्
1 रक्षाबन्धं विमुच्य चेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / पवित्रं
मूलतो दद्याद्रक्षार्थं तद्विसृज्य चेति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 पवित्रकं त्वञ्च पूजायां हृदये वहेति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 106
विप्रान् भोजनवस्त्राद्यैर् दिवसं पक्षमेव वा //
36.m:
Having offered an oblation, he should satisfy the Vaiṣṇava guru with sacrificial fees;
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: "rakṣābandhaṃ vimucya ca" is the reading in manuscript Kha; "pavitraṃ mūlato dadyādrakṣārthaṃ tadvisṛjya ca" is the reading in manuscript Ña.]
[Footnote 2: "pavitrakaṃ tvañca pūjāyāṃ hṛdaye vaha" is the reading in manuscript Ña.]
[and] the brahmins with food, garments, and other gifts, for a day or even a fortnight.

36.s:
pavitraṃ snānakāle ca avatārya samarpayet /
anivāritamannādyaṃ dadyādbhuṅktetha ca svayaṃ //
36.d:
पवित्रं स्नानकाले च अवतार्य समर्पयेत् /
अनिवारितमन्नाद्यं दद्याद्भुङ्क्तेथ च स्वयं //
36.m: And taking off the sacred thread at the time of bathing, he should offer it [again]; / he should give unrestricted food and other provisions, and then eat himself.

36.s:
visarjane 'hni sampūjya pavitrāṇi visarjayet /
sāṃvatsarīmimāṃ pūjāṃ sampādya vidhivanmama //
36.d:
विसर्जने ऽह्नि सम्पूज्य पवित्राणि विसर्जयेत् /
सांवत्सरीमिमां पूजां सम्पाद्य विधिवन्मम //
36.m: Having performed worship on the day of dismissal, he should dismiss the sacred threads: / "Having performed this yearly worship of mine according to rule,

36.s:
vraja pavitrakedānīṃ viṣṇulokaṃ visarjitaḥ /
madhye someśayoḥ prārcya viṣvaksenaṃ hi tasya ca //
36.d:
व्रज पवित्रकेदानीं विष्णुलोकं विसर्जितः /
मध्ये सोमेशयोः प्रार्च्य विष्वक्सेनं हि तस्य च //
36.m: go now, O sacred thread, dismissed to the world of Viṣṇu!" / Having worshiped between Soma and Īśa, indeed Viṣvaksena and to him

36.s:
pavitrāṇi samabhyarcya brāhmaṇāya samarpayet /
yāvantastantavastasmin pavitre parikalpitāḥ //
36.d:
पवित्राणि समभ्यर्च्य ब्राह्मणाय समर्पयेत् /
यावन्तस्तन्तवस्तस्मिन् पवित्रे परिकल्पिताः //
36.m: having fully worshiped the sacred threads, he should present them to a brahmin. / As many threads as are fashioned in that sacred thread,

36.s:
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi viṣṇuloke mahīyate /
kulānāṃ śatamuddhṛtya daśa pūrvān daśāparān /
viṣṇulokaṃ tu saṃsthāpya svayaṃ muktimavāpnuyāt //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye viṣṇupavitrārohaṇaṃ nāma
ṣaṭtriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha saptatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
sarvadevapavitrārohaṇavidhiḥ
36.d:
तावद्युगसहस्राणि विष्णुलोके महीयते /
कुलानां शतमुद्धृत्य दश पूर्वान् दशापरान् /
विष्णुलोकं तु संस्थाप्य स्वयं मुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये विष्णुपवित्रारोहणं नाम
षट्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ सप्तत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
सर्वदेवपवित्रारोहणविधिः
36.m:
for so many thousands of cosmic ages he is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu. / Having delivered a hundred families—ten preceding and ten succeeding— / and establishing them in the world of Viṣṇu, he himself would attain liberation.
Thus in the ancient Great Purāṇa composed by Agni, the thirty-sixth chapter, named "The Investiture with Viṣṇu's Sacred Thread."
Now the thirty-seventh chapter:
The ritual rule for the investiture with sacred thread for all deities.

37.s:
agnir uvāca
saṅkṣepāt sarvadevānāṃ pavitrārohaṇaṃ(1) śṛṇu /
pavitra sarvalakṣma syāt svarasānalagaṃ tvapi //
37.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
सङ्क्षेपात् सर्वदेवानां पवित्रारोहणं(1) शृणु /
पवित्र सर्वलक्ष्म स्यात् स्वरसानलगं त्वपि //
37.m: Agni said: / Listen briefly to the investiture with sacred thread for all deities. / The sacred thread should possess all distinguishing marks, and it may also be placed in self-kindled fire.

37.s:
jagadyone samāgaccha parivāragaṇaiḥ saha /
nimantrayāmyahaṃ prātardadyāntubhyaṃ pavitrakaṃ ///
37.d:
जगद्योने समागच्छ परिवारगणैः सह /
निमन्त्रयाम्यहं प्रातर्दद्यान्तुभ्यं पवित्रकं ///
37.m: "O Source of the universe, come together with the hosts of your attendants! / I invite [you]; in the morning I shall give you the sacred thread."

37.s:
jagatsṛje(2) namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ /
:n
1 pavitrāropaṇamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 jagatsūte iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 107
pavitrīkaraṇārthāya varṣapūjāphalapradaṃ //
37.d:
जगत्सृजे(2) नमस्तुभ्यं गृह्णीष्वेदं पवित्रकं /
:न्
1 पवित्रारोपणमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 जगत्सूते इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 107
पवित्रीकरणार्थाय वर्षपूजाफलप्रदं //
37.m:
"Homage to you, O Creator of the universe! Please accept this sacred thread,
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: "pavitrāropaṇam" is the reading in manuscript Kha.]
[Footnote 2: "jagatsūte" is the reading in manuscript Ña.]
for the sake of purification, yielding the fruit of a year's worship."
"Homage to you, Lord Śiva! Please accept this sacred thread, / with garlands of gems and corals, with mandāra blossoms and other flowers:

37.s:
iyaṃ sāṃvatsarī pūjā tavāstu vedavitpate /
sāṃvatsarīmimāṃ pūjāṃ sampādya vidhimanmama //
37.d:
इयं सांवत्सरी पूजा तवास्तु वेदवित्पते /
सांवत्सरीमिमां पूजां सम्पाद्य विधिमन्मम //
37.m: May this yearly worship belong to you, O Lord who knows the Vedas! / Having performed this yearly worship of mine according to rule,

37.s:
vraja pavitrakedānīṃ svargalokaṃ visarjitaḥ /
sūryadeva namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ //
37.d:
व्रज पवित्रकेदानीं स्वर्गलोकं विसर्जितः /
सूर्यदेव नमस्तुभ्यं गृह्णीष्वेदं पवित्रकं //
37.m: go now, O sacred thread, dismissed to the heavenly world!" / "Homage to you, Sun god! Please accept this sacred thread,

37.s:
pavitrīkaraṇārthāya varṣapūjāphalapradaṃ /
śivadeva namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ //
37.d:
पवित्रीकरणार्थाय वर्षपूजाफलप्रदं /
शिवदेव नमस्तुभ्यं गृह्णीष्वेदं पवित्रकं //
37.m: for the sake of purification, yielding the fruit of a year's worship." / "Homage to you, Lord Śiva! Please accept this sacred thread,

37.s:
pavitrīkaraṇārthāya varṣapūjāphalapradaṃ /
vāṇeśvara(1) namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ //
37.d:
पवित्रीकरणार्थाय वर्षपूजाफलप्रदं /
वाणेश्वर(1) नमस्तुभ्यं गृह्णीष्वेदं पवित्रकं //
37.m: for the sake of purification, yielding the fruit of a year's worship." / "Homage to you, O Bāṇeśvara! Please accept this sacred thread,

37.s:
pavitrīkaraṇārthāya varṣapūjāphalapradaṃ /
śaktideva namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ //
37.d:
पवित्रीकरणार्थाय वर्षपूजाफलप्रदं /
शक्तिदेव नमस्तुभ्यं गृह्णीष्वेदं पवित्रकं //
37.m: for the sake of purification, yielding the fruit of a year's worship." / "Homage to you, Lord of Śakti! Please accept this sacred thread,
for the sake of purification, yielding the fruit of a year's worship." / The excellent thread consisting of Nārāyaṇa, consisting of Aniruddha,

37.s:
dhanadhānyāyurārogyapradaṃ sampradadāmi te /
kāmadevamayaṃ sūtraṃ saṅkarṣaṇamayaṃ varaṃ //
37.d:
धनधान्यायुरारोग्यप्रदं सम्प्रददामि ते /
कामदेवमयं सूत्रं सङ्कर्षणमयं वरं //
37.m: bestowing wealth, grain, long life, and health, I give to you. / The excellent thread consisting of Kāmadeva, consisting of Saṅkarṣaṇa,

37.s:
vidyāsantatisaubhāgyapradaṃ sampradadāmi te /
vāsudevamayaṃ sūtraṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadaṃ //
37.d:
विद्यासन्ततिसौभाग्यप्रदं सम्प्रददामि ते /
वासुदेवमयं सूत्रं धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदं //
37.m: bestowing knowledge, offspring, and good fortune, I give to you. / The thread consisting of Vāsudeva, bestowing righteousness, desire, wealth, and liberation,

37.s:
saṃsārasāgarottārakāraṇaṃ pradadāmi te /
viśvarūpamayaṃ sūtraṃ sarvadaṃ pāpanāśanaṃ //
:n
1 gaṇeśvara iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
2 paramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 108
37.d:
संसारसागरोत्तारकारणं प्रददामि ते /
विश्वरूपमयं सूत्रं सर्वदं पापनाशनं //
:न्
1 गणेश्वर इति ग, घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
2 परमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 108
37.m:
the cause of crossing over the ocean of worldly existence, I give to you. / The thread consisting of the Universal Form, all-bestowing and destroying sin,
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: "gaṇeśvara" is the reading in the three manuscripts Ga, Gha, and Ña.]
[Footnote 2: "param" is the reading in manuscript Ña.]

37.s:
atītānāgatakulasamuddhāraṃ dadāmi te /
kaniṣṭhādīni catvāri manubhistu kramāddade //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye saṅkṣepapavitrārohaṇaṃ nāma
saptatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha aṣṭatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
devālayanirmāṇaphalaṃ
37.d:
अतीतानागतकुलसमुद्धारं ददामि ते /
कनिष्ठादीनि चत्वारि मनुभिस्तु क्रमाद्ददे //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये सङ्क्षेपपवित्रारोहणं नाम
सप्तत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ अष्टत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
देवालयनिर्माणफलं
37.m:
delivering the past and future family, I give to you. / I gave the four [threads], the smallest and so on, in succession with the mantras.
Thus in the ancient Great Purāṇa composed by Agni, the thirty-seventh chapter, named "The Summary of the Investiture with Sacred Thread."
Now the thirty-eighth chapter:
The fruit of building a temple.
